notes.title: Ver. 3.28 Update Note
notes.content:
[p][img src="https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q2/1014/updatebanner.png?width=1000&height=&mode=max"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Hello, this is the Vindictus team.[/p][p]Below are the list of changes available after the version update on September 23rd, 2025.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Table of Contents[/b][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]1. Character Utility Improvements[/p][list][*][p]Fiona - Common[/p][/*][*][p]Fiona - Longsword[/p][/*][*][p]Vella[/p][/*][/list][p]2. Skill Damage Adjustments[/p][list][*][p]Hurk - Greatsword[/p][/*][*][p]Letty[/p][/*][*][p]Evie - Staff[/p][/*][*][p]Delia[/p][/*][*][p]Danah[/p][/*][*][p]Lann - Twin Spears[/p][/*][/list][p]3. Wardrobe[/p][p]4. Mileage System[/p][p]5. Other Changes[/p][list][*][p]Expertise[/p][/*][*][p]Items[/p][/*][*][p]Battle[/p][/*][*][p]Redeemers[/p][/*][*][p]Story[/p][/*][/list][p]6. Misc.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p][b]1. Character Utility Improvements[/b][/p][p][b]Fiona - Common[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved the appearance of the character's face.[/p][list][*][p]You can read more about these improvements in the Developer's Notes. [url="https://vindictus.nexon.net/news/96329/developer-s-note-renewal-to-fiona-s-appearance"]\[Go to Developer's Notes][/url][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][list][*][p]Due to the makeup improvements, you will no longer be able to use the makeup you had previously equipped.[/p][list][*][p]You will be able to craft a "Fiona Makeup Coupon" via Quick Crafting by right-clicking on the item.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The eyebrow improvements may slightly change the type and shape of your existing eyebrows.[/p][list][*][p]Players who wish to change them will be able to earn a "Premium Appearance Alteration Coupon" in the upcoming event.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]With the addition of the new hair, mole, and scar, players who had Fiona before the appearance improvement update will receive a "Fiona Appearance Revamp Celebration Reward" in the mail.[/p][list][*][p]The contents of the reward are as follows.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][th][p][b]Item Name[/b][/p][/th][th][p][b]Item Characteristics[/b][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]Shield Maiden Braids[/p][/td][td][p]Bound to Character[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Hair Color Change Coupon (Binding)[/p][/td][td][p]Bound to Character[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Fiona's Mole[/p][/td][td][p]Bound to Character[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Fiona's Scar[/p][/td][td][p]Bound to Character[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p] [/p][list][*][p]Added the new status effect "Retribution" to the "Active: Taunt" skill.[/p][list][*][p]While the status effect "Retribution" is active, you gain 1 stage for each successful "Shield Deflection."[/p][/*][*][p]The status effect "Retribution" increases your final damage by 3% per stage, up to a maximum of 5 stages (final damage increased by 15%).[/p][/*][*][p]The status effect "Retribution" lasts for the duration of the "Taunt" effect, and disappears when the status effect "Taunt" ends.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Modified the effect duration for "Active: Taunt" to be as follows.[/p][/*][/list][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][th][p][b]Rank[/b][/p][/th][th][p][b]Previous[/b][/p][/th][th][p][b]Modified[/b][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]F[/p][/td][td][p]12s[/p][/td][td][p]12s[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]E[/p][/td][td][p]14s[/p][/td][td][p]13s[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]D[/p][/td][td][p]16s[/p][/td][td][p]14s[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]C[/p][/td][td][p]18s[/p][/td][td][p]15s[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]B[/p][/td][td][p]20s[/p][/td][td][p]16s[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]A[/p][/td][td][p]22s[/p][/td][td][p]17s[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]9[/p][/td][td][p]24s[/p][/td][td][p]18s[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]8[/p][/td][td][p]26s[/p][/td][td][p]19s[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]7[/p][/td][td][p]28s[/p][/td][td][p]20s[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]6[/p][/td][td][p]30s[/p][/td][td][p]20s[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p] [/p][list][*][p]Added an effect where hitting an enemy with "Stigma Hammer" while equipped with a Large Shield will increase the duration of the status effect "Taunt" by 5 seconds.[/p][list][*][p]The duration can be increased up to four times (for a total increase of 20 seconds).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Changed the "Active: Taunt" skill usage condition from "Available in normal raids" to "Available in all battles."[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][list][*][p]Hitting an enemy with "Active: Taunt" triggers the status effect "Taunt" and instantly grants you 1 stage of the status effect "Retribution."[/p][list][*][p]Added remaining duration to the status effect "Retribution" UI.[/p][/*][*][p]While the status effect "Taunt" is active, hitting an enemy with Stigma Hammer while equipped with a Large Shield restores 100 SP.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Hitting an enemy with "Stigma Hammer" while equipped with a Large Shield will increase the duration of the status effect "Taunt" and the status effect "Retribution" by 5 seconds each.[/p][list][*][p]The duration of the status effect "Retribution" can also be increased up to four times (for a total increase of 20 seconds).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Adjusted the tooltip description for the "Active: Taunt" skill to match the changes above.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new attack skill "Active: Taunt Strike."[/p][list][*][p]This skill is a leap into the air followed by a slam into the ground, hitting enemies and attracting their attention for a short time.[/p][/*][*][p]"Active: Taunt Strike" also grants the "Taunt" effect when used, but the duration does not change with skill rank and is fixed at 5 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]In this state, you cannot gain the "Retribution" status effect from a successful "Shield Deflection."[/p][/*][*][p]While the "Taunt" status effect gained from using the 'Active: Taunt' skill is active, using "Active: Taunt Strike" does not remove or renew the existing "Taunt" effect.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Changed the Smash enhancement effect that is applied on a successful "Active: Shield Deflection" to not apply to "Active: Shield Bash."[/p][/*][*][p]Changed "Active: Shield Deflection" so that even if you fail to deflect, you can still chain into a normal attack, smash attack, or active skill after 60 frames.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted "Active: Shield Enhancement" and "Active: Tireless" SP consumption from 250 to 100 SP.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed "Heavy Stander Counter" so that it can chain after the third hit of a normal attack after a successful attack.[/p][/*][*][p]"Shield Mastery Rank 9" and "Large Shield Mastery" can now be learned without completing the Story "Skill Challenge: Shield Mastery."[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed "Active: Iron Defense" so that it no longer consumes SP when used.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the skill so that it cannot have "Waking Stone: Efficient SP" applied, as the skill's SP consumption has been removed.[/p][list][*][p]If the skill currently has the "Efficient SP" Waking Stone applied, the applied Waking Stone will be changed to Efficient SP (30) and the "awakening failure" state.[/p][/*][*][p]It will be changed to an "awakening failure" state to prevent the skill's max awakening info from being removed if the skill's Waking Stone info is also removed.[/p][/*][*][p]Also changed the lowest rank's Efficient SP (30) so that there is no limit for applicable ranks if you switch to a different Skill Awakening Stone in the future.[/p][/*][*][p]Based on the changes above, the following rewards will be distributed via mail to players who meet the distribution criteria below.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][th][p][b]Item Name[/b][/p][/th][th][p][b]Quantity[/b][/p][/th][th][p][b]Tradability[/b][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]The "Waking Stone: Efficient SP" that was applied[/p][/td][td][p]x1[/p][/td][td][p]Bound to Character[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Skill Awakening Assuring Erg (40%)[/p][/td][td][p]x2[/p][/td][td][p]Bound to Character[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Skill Awakening Assuring Erg (20%)[/p][/td][td][p]x1[/p][/td][td][p]Bound to Character[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Skill Awakening Delimiter Erg (60%) [/p][/td][td][p]x1[/p][/td][td][p]Bound to Character[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p] [/p][list][*][p]Changed "Honeybee Sting" and "Rose Thorns" (0-hit smash) to not apply the "Shield Deflection" status effect when used without charging.[/p][list][*][p]Using "Honeybee Sting" and "Rose Thorns" after charging will continue to apply the "Shield Deflection" status effect as before.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Modified the "Active: Shield Charge" skill to have critical applied.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][list][*][p]Revised tooltip descriptions so that skills can align with the character utility improvements.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]Fiona - Longsword[/b][/p][list][*][p]Modified the additional attack frame length for "Amaranth Kick" from 160 frames to 100 frames.[/p][/*][*][p]Modified the additional attack of "Amaranth Kick" so that the start of the attack hitbox is now at 23 frames instead of 29 frames.[/p][/*][*][p]Modified the additional attack of "Amaranth Kick" to consume 6 STA instead of 17 STA at max rank.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the "50 SP recovery effect" to "50 STA recovery effect" when "Amaranth Kick" additional attack hits.[/p][/*][*][p]Modified the point at which an "Amaranth Kick" additional attack can be chained to a guard action from "after 54 frames" to "after 40 frames."[/p][/*][*][p]Modified the point at which an "Amaranth Kick" additional attack can be chained to "Active: Shield Dash," activated by using the kick button, from "after 55 frames" to "after 41 frames."[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the damage of "Ivy Sweep" by 7%.[/p][/*][*][p]"Ivy Sweep" recovers 25 SP and 25 STA on successful hits.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][list][*][p]Increased the damage of counterattacks used after "Active: Shield Enhancement" by 6%.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the damage Force.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Changing the number of battles that need to be completed to earn Redeemers Seals and Mission Seals from 30 to 5.[/p][/*][*][p]Redeemers-related changes will be added to when "Arisha" smiles, the shape of her mouth looked awkward.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the ends of "Tessa's" hair looked awkward when equipping the "Cygne Rouge" hair.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where toggling "Hide Other Players' Mini-Windows" in "Options → Video → Advanced → Hide Mini" would reset the setting in certain situations.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p]We will always strive to do our best and provide you with the best Vindictus experience that we can.[/p][p]Thank you![/p]

notes.title: [Developer's Note] Additional Notice regarding updates to Key Stats
notes.content:
[p]Hello. This is DEV Allanon.[/p][p] [/p][p]After our previous Dev Note on our planned Stat Overhaul, we have been reviewing your opinions and questions across various regions and channels.[/p][p]Today, I plan to explain our intention behind these changes in more detail to resolve your questions and provide additional details on key points.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][p][b]Q. How should we understand the damage increase mechanic and stat investment efficiency?[/b][/p][p]A: We've found many players across regions were curious of how the new ATT and Destructive Power(Previously ATT Surplus) would actually work, and how their investment efficiency would be.[/p][list][*][p][b]Attack:[/b] This stat has a [b]curved efficiency structure[/b]: As your Attack stat gets higher, your damage increases, but its efficiency in growth gradually diminishes after a certain point (relative to the enemy's DEF).
Simply put, when your Attack is low compared to the enemy's DEF, investing in your ATT Stat increases your damage greatly. But once your ATT surpasses the monster's DEF, the rate of increase in damage gets smaller.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Destructive Power:[/b] Unlike ATT, this stat has a [b]linear efficiency structure:[/b] For every 1 point of Destructive Power, your final damage will [b]always[/b] increase by 0.001%. It is a fixed growth system that guarantees the same efficiency. (e.g., 1,000 Destructive Power = +1% Final)[/p][/*][/list][p]Because of these two different efficiency curves, there will be certain stat ranges in your character’s growth where the efficiency of investing in your ATT stat becomes lower than that of Destructive Power.[/p][p](* The new name for ATT Surplus is currently undecided. The term 'Destructive Power' may change upon official updates.)[/p][p] [/p][p]Here is a simple way to check which stat has better efficiency.[/p][list][*][p]See how much your expected damage increases when you add +1000 to your current ATT stat.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Compare this increase in damage with the 1% increase per +1000 addition to your current Destructive Power stat.[/p][/*][/list][p]For example, if raising your ATT stat by +1000 increases your damage by 3%, this means investing in ATT will be more efficient since investing +1000 in Destructive Power will only increase it by 1%.[/p][p]On the other hand, if an increase in ATT by +1000 increases your damage by below 1%, then your character is now more efficient when investing in Destructive Power.[/p][p][/p][p]In short, you can compare between [b]'The N% increase in damage per investment in +1000 ATT’ [/b]with [b]'The 1% increase in damage per investment in +1000 Destructive Power.'[/b][/p][p]Also, by considering the necessary materials/resources and their market prices, we believe it will become quite clear which stat will be best to invest in.[/p][p] [/p][p]We also plan to add a feature to the upcoming Test Server that allows you to check your character's applied stats for each battle via the updated UI.[/p][p]Below we’ve added an example of how we plan to use this UI to help you understand where your ATT stat is at in its efficiency curve.[/p][p]The details are still under development, and the final visuals may differ from the image below.[/p][p](The detailed numbers in the graph are examples. The actual values will differ by each player's stat growth.)[/p][p][img src="https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q3/1096/dev-note-img.png?width=5105&height=1200&mode=max"][/img][/p][p](* The Test server’s UI will be in Korean. Please refer to the additional comments in the image for the context.)[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: It seems like party entry requirements will become more complicated. Could you add a more intuitive metric like ‘Integrated Combat Power?’[/b][/p][p]A: We recognize the concern that after the update, as stat builds become more diverse it may become difficult to intuitively gauge a party member's strength. However, while the "Integrated Combat Power" metric many of you suggested could be convenient, we believe it would be difficult for it to accurately discern each character’s actual in-game strength.[/p][list][*][p]Since stat efficiency varies for each enemy’s DEF rate, it differs for each battle. Due to this, there could be cases where a certain party member has a high ‘combat power’ but shows low damage in actual battle.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Furthermore, if we were to create an ‘Integrated Combat Power,’ the one stat build that wields the highest combat power would be fixed as the ‘Meta Build’: which could eliminate diversity in stat investment and freedom of growth.[/p][/*][/list][p]Therefore, we plan to maintain the current stat system when calculating party entry restrictions for now.[/p][p]However, we will continue to closely monitor the data after the overhaul and will reconsider introducing an integrated combat power metric if confusion becomes significant.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: Won't ‘Attack Speed’ builds become more difficult?[/b][/p][p]A: Previously, due to the ATT Cap system, creating AS builds that converted leftover Critical or Balance stats into Attack Speed was one choice players could consider.[/p][p]We fully understand concerns that after the overhaul, sacrificing ATT stats for Attack Speed on enchantments will not be an adequate choice anymore, as the value of ATT will now be preserved across all ranges.[/p][p]Our Dev team is aware of this, and we are working hard to ensure a meaningful range of choices based on every player’s playstyle. Therefore, we are currently internally reviewing alternatives such as a higher tier Enchant Scroll that could inherit the role of the ‘Fast’ enchant while partially compensating for the loss of ATT stat.[/p][p]We will review multiple options and listen to your feedback from the Test Server operation. If necessary, we will prepare a solution at an appropriate time and provide you with another update.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: What happens to my previous investments in ATT Surplus?[/b][/p][p]A: Although its role will change, its value will still be preserved and, in most cases, will actually lead to a higher output.[/p][p]Previously, the value of ATT Surplus was only activated when “your ATT stat reached the cap."[/p][p]After the overhaul, this conditional system will be revamped to a synergistic structure. The [b]ATT Stat that was previously blocked by the cap will now be reflected in damage, which increases to overall base damage. At the same time, your existing ‘Destructive Power’ amplifies this new final damage once more.[/b][/p][p]In other words, two stats that were previously conditional will now work in a complementary way to ensure stable and high damage.[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][p][b]Global Test Server Operation Announcement[/b][/p][p]The Dev team is planning a [b]KR Test Server on Wednesday, September 10th[/b], to check the stability of the upcoming changes to major stats. This overhaul is an update that changes the very foundation of Vindictus itself, and players across all regions have shown great interest in it.[/p][p]Therefore, [b]for this Test Server only, we have decided to allow NA/EU region players to connect as well.[/b][/p][p]This update is not a change only limited to a specific region, but one that will apply equally to all players worldwide. We believe that listening to opinions from various countries from diverse environments is essential for a better structured update.[/p][p]For NA/EU region players, the Test server will be available after a thorough review of connection and gameplay in a global environment. We will announce additional details when the process is complete.[/p][p][/p][p]With the precious feedback from players around the world, we will do our best to repay you with an update that everyone can be satisfied with.[/p][p]We will continue to strengthen not only the stat system, but the overall game’s core foundation through the second half of 2025.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: [Developer's Note] Planned changes to Key Stats
notes.content: [p]Hello. This is DEV Allanon.[/p][p] [/p][p]I'd first like to express my sincere gratitude to everyone, for your deep affection for Vindictus over the years.[/p][p]Today, I'd like to explain into depth of our future plans on the 'Stat' system—an issue that many of you have been waiting for a change, and one that we, too, have considered one of our biggest challenges.[/p][p] [/p][p]We believe that many of you would likely have experienced moments where, despite investing immense cost and effort into your character's stats, you see minimal, or in some cases, no increase in damage in actual battle.[/p][p]This kind of situation where you can't see any difference in power, the feeling that your efforts are not being rewarded—we believe this is one of the critical barriers that prevent the enjoyment of growth.[/p][p]Following up on the stat system overhaul mentioned in our August Dev Talk, I'd like to provide a more detailed explanation of how we intend to fundamentally improve the system to ensure your efforts are well recognized for their full value.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="AFJWLZBmwNs;full"][/previewyoutube][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][p]The core of the problem—where you could not feel actual growth was in the old, flawed structure of our stat system, mainly intertwined with three key stats: ATT, ATT Surplus, and Counterforce.[/p][p] [/p][p]Each battle has its own 'Maximum Attack Cap' that cannot be surpassed. Any [b]ATT [/b]stat that exceeds this, even by a single point, was simply discarded.[/p][p]On the contrary, [b]ATT Surplus[/b] was only meaningful when your ATT Stat exceeded this 'Attack Cap.' It was a conditional stat with no benefits regardless of its amount unless your ATT stat had reached its maximum for that battle.[/p][p]Furthermore, [b]Counterforce[/b] was designed so that it would be required to deal 100% of your damage—As long as it met the requirements for each battle, any more of it would not grant any additional benefit either.[/p][p] [/p][p]As these three stats merged into our Battle system, a stagnation point appeared where your investments in stats did not transition to a tangible sense of growth: Which is why we have decided that it is time we conduct a complete overhaul of this structure.[/p][p] [/p][p]Before we started the overhaul, we made sure to keep these three guiding principles in the redesign process, based on our respect to your gameplay and asset value.[/p][list][*][p][b]Your Characters will not get any weaker than they are now.[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]There will no longer be any wasted stats.[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Flexibility in stat growth decisions will be expanded.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]We are well aware that a fundamental change to the damage formula in a Live-Service game may cause anxiety. However, the reason we decided to do so is by no means to weaken characters or make growth more difficult.[/p][p]On the contrary, it is to fully preserve the value of your gameplay you have built up so far and to ensure that your future efforts return to a more respectful outcome. All changes have been carefully designed so that your expected damage will be higher than, or at least equal to, what it was before.[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][p]The biggest change is the [b]removal of the 'Attack Cap.'[/b][/p][p] [/p][p][img src="https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q3/1089/applied-att-change.png"][/img][/p][p]The [b]Blue line[/b] in the graph above represents the previous ATT stat formula in 'Royal Castle Topaz Hall.'[/p][p]As you can see, the moment your ATT stat reaches 59,800, the applied ATT did not apply any more than it. This made your investments beyond this point meaningless.[/p][p] [/p][p]We have decided to remove this limitation. The [b]Green line[/b] in the graph represents the new ATT stat formula—A formula that supports constant growth. Its efficiency will simply become more gradual after a certain point.[/p][p]We understand that the graph above may seem like the revised version is under the former one, decreasing the damage compared to the current one. But there is more to this, which I will elaborate below.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q3/1090/expected-damage-change.png"][/img][/p][p]We came to the conclusion that if we were to simply remove the ATT cap and apply the current growth formula, the value of 'ATT' stat will skyrocket after a certain period of growth: Leading to extreme power inflation.[/p][p]In the long run, we believe this would potentially harm the game's overall balance and shorten the lifespan of the fun in gaming.[/p][p]The gradient efficiency slope we have applied is a choice to protect two values at once: the tangible feeling of growth and the stability of the game itself. As you can see from the [b]Green line[/b] above, the damage will not only be 'Higher' than the current system, but will also have a consistent increasing slope.[/p][p] [/p][p]This ensures that your effort for growth will always result in a meaningful outcome, while protecting the long-term enjoyment of playing.[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][p][b]We are also changing the role of 'ATT Surplus.'[/b][/p][p] [/p][p]The current ATT Surplus is a conditional stat only active when your ATT stat surpasses the ATT Cap for each battle. This also means that regardless of the amount of investment you put into growth, the stat will not take power in certain conditions.[/p][p]We aim to fix this unreasonable aspect and ensure that your efforts are always reflected in actual combat.[/p][p] [/p][p]Going forward, ATT Surplus will act as the most powerful and reliable stat that affects the character's [b]'Final Damage'[/b] by a percentage.[/p][p]Regardless of your ATT Stat, you will be able to see an increase in damage directly in proportion to how much you invest in your ATT Surplus.[/p][p]Accordingly, we plan to change the name to more clearly define the new role of ATT Surplus. We will introduce the details and the new localized name when implementation is ready.[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][p][b]'Counterforce' will also be redefined.[/b][/p][p] [/p][p]Previously, Counterforce was more of a 'Forced Requirement' than a 'Benefit.' It was a stat that was required to deal 100% of your damage.[/p][p]At the same time, it did not grant any additional benefit when it was invested beyond the minimum requirement either.[/p][p] [/p][p]We are redefining Counterforce to a [b]'Defense Reduction Stat'[/b] that directly penetrates enemy's defense. Each point of Counterforce will now ignore 5.0 of the enemy's total defense, acting as a new pillar of offense.[/p][p]The more you invest in the redefined Counterforce, the weaker the enemy will become: making each and every attack you make hit harder.[/p][p] [/p][p]With the change of role, all enemy's 'Counterforce Resistance Stat' will be removed accordingly. Also, Counterforce will be renamed as well to fit its new role. [/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][p]To address these changes in more detail, I've attached some 3D graphs that visualize how the new formula affects your gameplay outcomes.[/p][p]The graph below represents the expected change in damage based on your ATT and ATT Surplus values, in the Romel Battle: The [b]Green surface[/b] is the results of the old formula, and the [b]Purple surface[/b] is the expected results from the revised formula.[/p][p]The height of each surface is the expected damage, and as you can see, the new formula's expected damage surface is always, and overwhelmingly surpassing that of the old formula.[/p][p](The graph assumes that other stats—Balance, Critical, and Counterforce, are maxed out.)[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q3/1091/romel_damage_comparison_final_5s_en.gif"][/img][/p][p]The [b]Blue[/b] and [b]Red[/b] dots on the graph are virtual player data, that represents players that can enter Quick Battle, and players with maximum available stats.[/p][p]As seen in the graph, the revised formula results in a minimum of 21% to maximum of 99% increase in damage compared to the current system.[/p][p]This increase is especially significant for those whose growth had stagnated under the current formula, and even players with maximum stats can still expect approximately 26% increase in damage despite their current powerful state—Granting even greater value for your investment.[/p][p] [/p][p]These changes are not limited just to the Romel battle: As seen in the expected changes for other raids below, these positive change appears consistently across all major battles.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q3/1094/irusan_damage_comparison_final_5s_en.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q3/1093/sreng_damage_comparison_final_5s_en.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q3/1092/lucian_damage_comparison_final_5s_en.gif"][/img][/p][p]The visual graphs and data might seem complex. To summarize, the new formula will affect your gameplay in two ways:[/p][p][b]1. Intuitive Stat growth will be available, as all growth will now be reflected in your final damage.[/b][/p][p]Every change, from a small change in accessory or applying a slightly higher enchantment, will now clearly transition into increase in damage.[/p][p]You will now be able to feel the joy of growth across all periods of gameplay, with your efforts directly reflected in your combat results.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]2. Expanded flexibility in growth.[/b][/p][p]The current system requires you to build your stats in a seemingly fixed order. But now with the revised system, you can now choose your growth path more freely, as all stats will increase your play results.[/p][p]While you currently must stick to a set path in gearing due to stat cap limitations, the new formula will allow you to grow more efficiently using the materials you have, or those with the most stable marketplace prices.[/p][p] [/p][p]The process of deciding your growth path will shift from a forced choice to avoid limitations, to a more enjoyable, strategic decision on how to get stronger more efficiently.[/p][p]As a result, we believe everyone will be able to experience a more pleasent and logical growth process with progressions flows without blockages.[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][p]We do not plan to complete such a critical and massive change into the game based solely on our development team's judgements.[/p][p]To create the best possible outcome, we would like to work on it with you and listen to your feedback and opinions on this change. We will be conducting a test server in [b]early September[/b], and we will introduce this new formula there for the first time.[/p][p] [/p][p]The purpose of the next Test Server goes beyond just finding unspotted bugs: We earnestly hope that you experience this new system firsthand and give us your honest feedback on how it feels.[/p][p]During this period, we will be monitoring suggestions and opinions from various communities across regions more closely than ever, while also analyzing quantitative data like combat metrics and results to review the impact of this change.[/p][p] [/p][p]Despite our efforts to explain our plans in detail, we believe that many of you will still have questions. We've attached a short Q&A below to help address them:[/p][p][b]Q. Will my character get stronger than they are now?[/b][/p][p][b]A.[/b] Yes. The guiding principle of this overhaul is respect for player value. For all players who can enter a given battle, the new system is designed so that your expected damage is higher than, or at least equal to, the previous formula.[/p][p]We will make sure that there will be no cases where you become weaker.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q. In the first graph, the applied ATT after the change is lower than before in certain sections. Will this not make my character weaker?[/b][/p][p][b]A.[/b] It is true that in certain sections of the graph, the applied Attack value itself—which is an intermediate step in the damage calculation—is lower than before. However, the combat damage calculation formula itself has been newly designed to address this.[/p][p]Previously, the applied ATT stat determined most of the damage. Now, after calculating the base damage from applied Attack, Counterforce weakens the monster's defense, and ATT Surplus is added as a powerful final damage increase by percentage.[/p][p]Therefore, the final damage output, despite the ATT graph below the current version, will be higher after the changes.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q. Previously, ATT Surplus was not mandatory other than Space-Time Distortion Battles. This change seems it would make it relevant for all battles.[/b][/p][p][b]A.[/b] Yes, it is true that in our past Dev Talk, I have mentioned that ATT Surplus will not be required outside Space-Time Distortions.[/p][p]To be honest, the previous direction was set due to the unreasonable nature of the old ATT Surplus—Which only worked under specific conditions. We did not want to force players to invest in a poorly performing stat, concerned it would only create more stress. At the time, we judged that leaving a flawed stat in the realm of choice was the best way to lessen your burden.[/p][p]However, we concluded that leaving a flawed stat, even as an option, was not a fundamental solution. The existence of a stat that players avoid was a challenge for our team to solve. The true solution was to make ATT Surplus itself attractive and valuable to everyone. With this overhaul, we expect ATT Surplus will no longer be an unreasonable stat. It is reborn as a core stat that guarantees the most certain sense of growth by directly increasing final damage.[/p][p]To answer your question, it will still not be included in the 'mandatory entry requirements' for content other than Space-Time Distortion, as is the case now.[/p][p]However, it is true that it has become a core stat that provides the most definitive reward for getting stronger. Our goal is to make you want to invest in it because of its clear appeal, not because of a requirement. We sincerely apologize for the confusion caused by the difference between our past statements and our current direction. We ask for your generous understanding that this was a decision to move toward a better direction where all growth is enjoyable by solving a fundamental problem, rather than maintaining a flawed system.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q. Will Mysterious/Abyssal Crystals still be required to raise ATT Surplus?[/b][/p][p][b]A.[/b] Yes, the use of Mysterious/Abyssal Crystals will be maintained after the update. We have determined that the current value of Mysterious/Abyssal Crystals is sufficiently appropriate for the new standing of this powerful stat.[/p][p]Furthermore, Mysterious/Abyssal Shards have long been a crucial pillar of the in-game economy. Drastically changing the sources or uses of this material could undermine the value of the efforts of those who have already collected many of them, so we are approaching this very cautiously.[/p][p]We will continuously monitor whether the sources of key materials are overly concentrated in specific content after this update, and whether there are excessive changes in the overall supply balance and market prices.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q. If everyone gets stronger, won't battles become less fun?[/b][/p][p][b]A.[/b] We are taking into account that battle times will be shortened by a massive amount immediately after the update to respect your player value. We will do our best to avoid updates that diminish the growth experience by artificially raising the defense or health of existing monsters.[/p][p]Of course, new raid battles to be introduced in the future will be designed with difficulties based on the post-overhaul stats to maintain the enjoyment of the challenge. But we promise to adjust this gradually so that it does not feel like a sudden hurdle.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q. Are there any places where this new formula will not apply?[/b][/p][p][b]A.[/b] Yes, in certain contents where character stats are fixed (Ein Lacher, Guild Dungeon, Friendship Missions, etc.), the existing formula will be maintained to avoid any confusion in your gameplay experience.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q. With the stat formula changing, will there be an impact on Ranking Points?[/b][/p][p][b]A.[/b] If your character's stats do not change, your Ranking Points will remain the same before and after the revision.[/p][p] [/p][p]Q. If I send feedback about the changes, will it really be reflected?[/p][p][b]A.[/b] Yes. This test period is the most crucial process for us to hear your voices before finalizing the numbers.[/p][p]If we determine there is a balance issue based on data and feedback, or if better improvement suggestions are presented, we will boldly make revisions before the official server update and communicate with you again. We look forward to your active participation.[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][p]What we shared today is about more than just a numerical adjustment; it is our commitment to improving issues that has held Vindictus back for a long time and to restoring the fundamental value of the game: the joy of growth.[/p][p]After a valuable feedback process in early September, we will present a new era of growth to all players through the official server update in October.[/p][p] [/p][p]We once again express our deepest gratitude to all of you who are always with Vindictus.[/p][p]Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: You Were Never Wrong: Lucian
notes.content: [p]Hello! This is the Vindictus team.[/p][p]The newest raid is called [b]Unjust Cathedral[/b].[/p][p]You can depart for [b]Unjust Cathedral[/b] in Toward Taratha at the Taratha Royal Castle region.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="4Uy1uGx5xsU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]With the power of the ring at his disposal, Enok developed a new variety of geas and performed ruthless experiments on the Northfall prisoners.[/p][p]Even the justice that [b]Lucian[/b] so desperately longed for was swallowed up by the despair engineered by Enok.[/p][p]The Taratha Cathedral, which once preached justice to the faithful, had lost its light.[/p][p]In a place of contradictions, devoid of justice, a group of heroes must battle an enraged knight.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q3/1029/img1.jpg?width=1550&height=872&mode=max"][/img]<Enraged Lucian>[/p][p][/p][p]Infected by the new geas, Lucian has lost his sanity, and parts of his body have been transformed. [/p][p]He wreaks havoc on the heroes with his quick, erratic movements.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q3/1030/img2.jpg?width=1550&height=872&mode=max"][/img]<Lucian charging quickly>[/p][p] [/p][p]When Lucian goes berserk, parts of the battlefield are destroyed, and he becomes more aggressive. [/p][p] [/p][p][img src="https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q3/1031/img3.jpg?width=1550&height=872&mode=max"][/img]<Berserk Lucian>[/p][p] [/p][p]Keeping your distance to avoid the enraged Lucian's merciless attacks can be quite dangerous. [/p][p]In an instinctive move, he aims for the back of a distant target. [/p][p] [/p][p][img src="https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q3/1032/img4.jpg?width=1550&height=872&mode=max"][/img]<Lucian moving to a distant target to attack them>[/p][p] [/p][p]Be careful not to get hit by his signature attack, which is a series of quick teleportations followed by a barrage of attacks.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q3/1033/img5.jpg?width=1550&height=872&mode=max"][/img]<Lucian teleports and attacks quickly>[/p][p] [/p][p]The Season 4 Episode 12 raid, [b]Unjust Cathedral[/b], will be live soon.[/p][p] [/p][p]As always, we will do our best to provide you with a great gaming experience.[/p][p]Thank you for supporting Vindictus![/p]

notes.title: New Item Guide - Secondary Currency: Airgead
notes.content: [p]Hello, this is the Vindictus team.[/p][p] [/p][p]We are excited to introduce Airgead, a secondary currency now available in Vindictus after the server update of July 15th.[/p][p]Airgead can be acquired from the Supply Depot with NX or exchanged for your in-game Gold at the Trading Post: And they can then be used to purchase a variety of NX items![/p][hr][/hr][p][b]1. How to Exchange Airgead[/b][/p][p]You can add Airgead to your account in two ways: by purchasing it from the Supply Depot using NX, or by exchanging it for Gold at the Trading Post.[/p][p] [/p][p]When you purchase Airgead with NX, it will be delivered to your Temporary Storage Chest.[/p][p]You must retrieve and use the item from the chest to add the Airgead to your account balance.[/p][p]Your account can hold a maximum of 2.1 billion Airgead.[/p][p] [/p][p]You can view your current Airgead balance at any time in the Supply Depot or Trading Post UI.[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p][b]2. Using Airgead[/b][/p][p]Airgead can be used to purchase items from the Supply Depot and the Avatar Shop. Items eligible for purchase with Airgead will be clearly marked.[/p][p]Please be aware that some items purchased with Airgead may be designated only as 'Account Sharable'.[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p][b]3. Where & How to use the Trading Post[/b][/p][p]The Trading Post is located next to the Colhen [b]Marketplace Message Board.[/b][/p][p][b][img src="https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q3/1010/airgead_2.png?width=900&height=506&mode=max"][/img][/b][/p][p][b][img src="https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q3/1011/airgead_3.png?width=700&height=242&mode=max"][/img][/b][/p][p] [/p][p]The Trading Post UI has three main tabs:[/p][list][*][p][b]Purchase Gold[/b]: View listings of Gold currently for sale, sorted by the lowest price.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Sell Gold[/b]: List your own Gold for sale in exchange for Airgead.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Sell List[/b]: Manage and track the Gold you have currently listed for sale.[/p][/*][/list][p]Please note that all transactions at the Trading Post are conducted in units of [b]1,000,000(1M)[/b] Gold.[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p][b]4. How to Purchase & Sell from the Trading Post[/b][/p][p][b]1) To Purchase Gold[/b][/p][p]Enter the total amount of Gold (in millions) you wish to buy and click the 'Purchase' button.[/p][p]The system will automatically buy the requested amount, starting from the cheapest listings currently available.[/p][p] [/p][p]When doing so, we recommend checking [b]Yesterday's Average Purchase per 1 Million[/b] on the top of the list for the general market sales rate.[/p][p][img src="https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q3/1012/airgead_4.png?width=900&height=650&mode=max"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q3/1013/airgead_5.png?width=350&height=322&mode=max"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Once confirmed, the purchased Gold will be sent to your in-game mailbox.[/p][p]All purchases are final and cannot be undone.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]2) To Sell Gold[/b][/p][p]In the 'Sell Gold' tab, enter the total amount of Gold you wish to sell (in millions) and set the Airgead price you want to receive per 1M Gold.[/p][p]The UI will show you the total Airgead you will receive after the sale is complete, before fees.[/p][p][img src="https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q3/1014/airgead_6.png?width=900&height=650&mode=max"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q3/1015/airgead_7.png?width=350&height=343&mode=max"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]To prevent errors, you must type [b]'Sale Price confirmed.' [/b]into the confirmation box to list your item.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]3) To Cancel a Sale[/b][/p][p][img src="https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q3/1016/airgead_8.png?width=901&height=650&mode=max"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q3/1017/airgead_9.png?width=351&height=247&mode=max"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]From the 'Sell List' tab, you can view your active listings, including the remaining time.[/p][p]To cancel a sale, simply press the 'X' button next to the corresponding listing.[/p][p]The Gold will be returned to your mailbox, but the initial listing fee will not be refunded.[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p][b]5. Trading Post Fees & Policies[/b][/p][p]All transactions involving the sale of Gold are subject to the following fees:[/p][p][b]1) Listing Fee[/b]: A fee of [b]1% of the total Gold value[/b] is charged when you list an item for sale.[/p][list][*][p]This fee is refunded if your listing expires unsold.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]This fee is not refunded if the sale is successful or if you manually cancel the listing.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]2) Sales Fee[/b]: When your Gold is sold, a [b]10% transaction fee[/b] is deducted from the Airgead you receive. The final amount is then sent to your mailbox.[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p][b]6. Please Note[/b][/p][list][*][p]All Gold and Airgead from the Trading Post is delivered to your in-game mailbox.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Mail from the Trading Post expires in 30 days. You must claim the contents before then, or they will be permanently deleted.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]If your inbox contains more than 36 messages, you may not see new mail. Please delete older messages to view the most recent ones.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p]

notes.title: Ver. 3.26 Update Note
notes.content:
[p]
[img src="https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q2/1014/updatebanner.png?width=1000&height=&mode=max"][/img][/p][p]Hello, this is the Vindictus team.[/p][p]Below are the list of changes available after the version update on July 15th, 2025.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Table of Contents[/b][/p][p]1. Character Utility Improvements[/p][list][*][p]Vella - Common[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Vella - Twin Swords[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Vella - Twin Chainblades[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Evie - Battle Scythe[/p][/*][/list][p]2. Items[/p][p]3. New Currency: Airgead[/p][p]4. Misc.[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p][b]1. Character Utility Improvements[/b][/p][p][b]\[Vella][/b][/p][p]1) Common[/p][list][*][p]Improved the appearance of the character's face.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]You can read more about these improvements in our previous notice [b][url="https://vindictus.nexon.net/news/96245/developer-s-note-renewal-to-vella-s-appearance"]\[Here][/url][/b][/p][/*][/list][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p][b]Developer's Notes[/b][/p][p]We've been listening closely to all the valuable feedback you've shared regarding Vella's face model renewal.[/p][p]Vindictus operates on a single global build, meaning core assets like character models are the same for all regions.
This makes it difficult for us to adjust the NA/EU/ update schedule for contents that has already been applied elsewhere, and we sincerely ask for your understanding.[/p][p]We completely understand that the new look may not be to everyone's preference.
With that in mind, we've prepared a small gift to show our appreciation: We will be giving a 'Premium Appearance Alteration Coupon' to everyone who logs in, and we hope it helps you customize Vella's new appearance to better match your own personal style.[/p][p]As always, we sincerely thank you for your incredible passion and support for Vindictus.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p] [/p][p]2) Twin Swords[/p][list][*][p]Changed Cross Stance to grant an additional 50 SP if you hit an enemy with a Pure Cross Cut within 40 frames of using it.[/p][/*][*][p]Made a fix so that attacks that did not activate Cross Cut prior to this change are able to be blocked while in Cross Stance.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the Blade Heart status effect by one stage.[/p][list][*][p]Changed the existing stage 3 effect, "Recover 2 STA on hit, gain 14 ATT SPD", to a base stage effect.[/p][/*][*][p]The icon for the Blade Heart status effect will be changed to the old stage 2 icon.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Changed the Blade Heart status effect by removing its duration, allowing it to last for an unlimited amount of time.[/p][list][*][p]However, the status effect will still disappear if you are hit while under its effect.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Changed Active: Wind Rider to no longer consume Blade Heart when used.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed Active: Wind Rider to restore 250 SP when used while under the Blade Heart status effect.[/p][list][*][p]The Blade Heart status effect has been consolidated into a single stage, changing the way SP is recovered as opposed to being based on the stage of the Blade Heart status effect.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Changed the cooldown time of Active: Wind Rider from 5 seconds to 15 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the SP consumption of Active: Sword's Will from 500 to 250.[/p][list][*][p]Adjusted the Blade Heart status effect gained from using Active: Sword's Will to 'Recover 3 STA on hit, gain 15 ATT SPD.' (Previous Effect: 'Recover 2 STA on hit, gain 14 ATT SPD')[/p][/*][*][p]The icon for the Blade Heart status effect gained from using Active: Sword's Will will display as the old stage 3 icon.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added a Super Armor effect to the Gust Sting skill animation.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the STA consumption of Slipaway and Backlash from 20 to 10.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed Cross Cut to be usable on attacks that previously did not activate Cross Cut.[/p][list][*][p]The attack above will always activate as Pure Cross Cut.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Adjusted the skill damage increase for Blade Heart to the following:[/p][/*][/list][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][td][p][b]Rank [/b][/p][/td][td][p][b]Previous[/b][/p][/td][td][p][b]Updated[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]E[/p][/td][td][p]10%[/p][/td][td][p]25%[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]D[/p][/td][td][p]12%[/p][/td][td][p]26%[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]C[/p][/td][td][p]14%[/p][/td][td][p]28%[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]B[/p][/td][td][p]16%[/p][/td][td][p]30%[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]A[/p][/td][td][p]18%[/p][/td][td][p]32%[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]9[/p][/td][td][p]20%[/p][/td][td][p]34%[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]8[/p][/td][td][p]22%[/p][/td][td][p]36%[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]7[/p][/td][td][p]24%[/p][/td][td][p]38%[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]6[/p][/td][td][p]25%[/p][/td][td][p]40%[/p][/td][/tr][/table][list][*][p]Changed Active: Typhoon Slash to be able to receive the Blade Heart status effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the damage of Active: Gale Cutter by 20%.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the damage of Cross Cut and Pure Cross Cut by 10%.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the damage of Double Cross and Pure Double Cross by 15%.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the damage of Active: Typhoon Slash by 15%.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed Active: Typhoon Slash so that it cannot be chained after using Double Cross.[/p][list][*][p]The skill description for Active: Typhoon Slash has been adjusted to match the changes listed above.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Removed the following text from the skill description for Double Cross.[/p][list][*][p]You can ONLY use this skill after dealing damage with Cross Cut.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p][b]Developer's Notes[/b][/p][p]We gave the option to use Active: Typhoon Slash after Double Cross to quickly break the combo if the situation warranted it, but it felt disjointed and inefficient for the feel of the overall combo, so we have removed the chaining.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][list][*][p]Changed Active: Typhoon Slash so that it can be chained after using Active: Gale Cutter or Double Cross.[/p][list][*][p]Adjusted any chained Active: Typhoon Slash to have an evasive frame.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Changed Gust Sting so that it cannot be chained after using Double Cross.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the shortcut keys for Backlash and Slipaway as follows.[/p][list][*][p][b]Before[/b] - Dodge \[Space] after Cross Stance or Storm Step[/p][/*][*][p][b]After[/b] - Kick \[R] after Cross Stance or Storm Step[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Changed skill descriptions to match the changes to Vella - Twin Swords.[/p][list][*][p]Preview videos for the changed skills will be fixed at a later date.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]3) Twin Chainblades[/p][list][*][p]Changed Active: Red Blizzard to no longer consume SP.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed so that using Active: Red Blizzard reduces the cooldown of Active: Frostbite by 20 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the cooldown time of Active: Red Blizzard from 10 seconds to 20 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed Active: Red Blizzard to grant the new status effect, Bloodstain, when used.[/p][list][*][p]While affected by Bloodstain, using Active: Frostbite will restore 500 SP, then remove the status effect.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Changed the SP consumption of Active: Frostbite from 500 to 100.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the horizontal width of Active: Glacial Strike's attack range by 1.3 times.[/p][/*][*][p]Added evasive frames to the second and third attacks of Active: Blade Dance.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the STA consumption of Glint Rank A from 11 to 10.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed skill descriptions to match the changes to Vella - Twin Chainblades.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]\[Evie][/b][/p][p]1) Battle Scythe[/p][list][*][p]Changed Blade Shift and Demon Splitter so that they create a Spirit Bind when used.[/p][/*][*][p]Added evasive frames to Horrific Scream, Soul Skewer, and Dimensional Loom.[/p][list][*][p]If at Rank 9 or above, the additional attacks used via smash do not gain evasive frames.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Changed Blink so that drains are still possible when it is used after Soul Skewer and Dimensional Loom's additional attacks.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an evasive frame to the drain animation.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed Active: Void Star so that when used, it reduces the cooldown time of Active: Arcane Gate by 10 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed Active: Void Star, so that after use, Blink can be chained after 55 frames, instead of 83.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the SP consumption of Active: Void Star from 250 to 125.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the SP consumption of Active: Insane Reaper from 500 to 300.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where being hit by an enemy while using Active: Arcane Gate would intermittently Items[/b][/p][list][*][p]It is now possible to receive battle completion gold rewards when using Resenlian's Battle Completion Scroll.[/p][list][*][p]When using the Battle Completion Scroll, you can view the estimated gold reward in the pop-up UI.[/p][/*][*][p]As before, you can choose whether to apply a Core Boost, and your gold rewards will be adjusted accordingly.[/p][/*][*][p]Gold rewards are adjusted based on whether the secondary mission from the previous battle was met.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p][b]3. New Currency: Airgead[/b][/p][list][*][p]With the July 15th update, the secondary currency: Airgead, will be available in the North American and European servers.[/p][/*][*][p]Airgead can be used to purchase in-game gold through the Gold Trading Post, or to purchase cash items in the Supply Depot and Avatar Shop.[/p][/*][*][p]You can hold up to 2.1 billion Airgead at once.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Airgead must be moved from the NX Storage Chest to the Storage Chest after purchasing to be used for recharging.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Find more details on how to obtain and use Airgead in our previous notice [b][url="https://vindictus.nexon.net/news/96283"]\[Here][/url][/b][/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p][b]4. notes.title: GM Coin S5: Vacation Postcards
notes.content:
[p]
[img src="https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q2/1066/homepage_1920x663.jpg?width=1283&height=443&mode=max"][/img][/p][p][b]Event Period[/b][/p][p]June 17th, 2025 (After Maintenance) - Aug 12th, 2025 (Before Maintenance) [/p][p][/p][p]Mercenaries,[/p][p]Summer is here in Vindictus, and Summer means a Summer Vacation![/p][p]Take a screenshot of yourself enjoying the summer mood, and write a short message to go with the image.  You can write to your friends and family, in-game NPCs, Bosses, Objects, anything![/p][p](If you want to write a postcard to a luminary tree, you can.)[/p][p][/p][p]So... who're you writing to?[/p][p][/p][p][b]Event Details[/b][/p][p]1.To celebrate the summer season, take an in-game screenshot that represents the theme of "summer". [/p][list][*][p]Capture the concept of summer in a variety of ways, including clothing, locations and backgrounds, situations, and poses.[/p][/*][*][p]You can also decorate your screenshots with drawings, stickers, and more.[/p][/*][/list][p]2. Along with the screenshot you took, submit a short message you'd like to say to the person you want to send the postcard to.[/p][list][*][p]The recipient can be any person or object that can be encountered in-game, including other players, in-game NPCs, bosses, monsters, and even in-game geographical features.[/p][/*][*][p]If the message contains offensive or abusive content, or content that harms the essence of the event, the user's submission will be considered invalid, and they will be banned from the event.[/p][/*][*][p]Messages must comply with the Vindictus Discord server's community guidelines.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]Check more details from the Homepage Notice Below:[/p][p][url="https://vindictus.nexon.net/news/96267" style="button"]LINK[/url][/p]

notes.title: A Prophecy That Cannot Be Followed: Morgant
notes.content:
Hello! This is the Vindictus team.
The newest raid is called [b]A Prophecy That Cannot Be Followed[/b].

The enemy you'll be facing in this raid, [b]Morgant[/b], is a magical blademaster of the Draugr.
In ancient times, this mysterious but brilliant civilization flourished deep beneath Ben Chenner, a Fomor sect that worshipped the Fomor God.
However, when Elchulus fell into a slumber and Ben Chenner burned down to the Blazing Mountain, they vanished from history.

From the ranks of those Draugr, lost to the shadows of time, emerges Morgant.
Despite his calling as a member of the Silent Knights, he is a secretive and complex character who trusts no one.
Soon, his quest for the truth will lead to a fateful encounter, and a first confrontation, with our heroes.

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q2/1030/morgant1.jpg[/img]
<Morgant striking at his surroundings with his magic sword.>

Morgant employs a flashy blade-based combat style with his [b]magic sword[/b], which has been imbued with incredible power.
When this sword is further enchanted, it temporarily changes form, extending into an [b]Erg Blade[/b] that poses a grave threat to the heroes.
Targets hit by the Erg Blade will be inflicted with an [b]Erg Wound[/b].

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q2/1031/morgant2.jpg[/img]
<Morgant readying an attack through his magic sword's Erg Blade.>

The unique fighting style of a spellsword manifests not only through swordsmanship, but also through sorcerous force.
The [b]sigils[/b] he etches onto the battlefield will react to Erg Wounds and spark powerful explosions, so beware this synergy.

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q2/1032/morgant3.jpg[/img]
<Morgant enchanting an area through the power of his magic sword.>

Additionally, he can defend himself from the heroes' attacks with a [b]magic shield[/b], occasionally unleashing fluctuating attacks.

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q2/1033/morgant4.jpg[/img]
<Morgant defending himself with his magic shield.>

As the battle draws to an end, Morgant channels the power contained in his Erg Blade outward in all directions.
Powerful energy will engulf the entire battle arena, requiring quick responses.

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q2/1034/morgant5.jpg[/img]
<Morgant summons the power contained in his Erg Blade.>

Time marches on, and the hero's party marches towards confrontation. We wish you all the very best!
Please stay tuned for our upcoming update... the Vindictus Season 4 Episode 11 Raid, [b]A Prophecy That Cannot Be Followed[/b].

As always, we will do our best to provide you with a great gaming experience.
Thank you!

notes.title: Ver. 3.23 Update Note
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q2/1014/updatebanner.png?width=1000&height=&mode=max[/img]

Hello, this is the Vindictus team.
Below are the list of changes available after the version update on [b]April 22nd, 2025.[/b]

[b]Table of Contents[/b]
[olist][*]Character Utility Updates[/*][*]Game Loading Screen[/*][*]Misc.[/*][/olist]
 
[b]1. Character Utility Updates[/b]

[b]Lann - Common[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a new status effect to Critical Break.
[*] If you do not get a Critical hit with a Smash attack, you gain the 'CRIT RTE Boost' status effect.
[*] This status effect stacks and increases your next attack's Critical value based on its stage. 
[*] Your maximum Critical limit does not apply to the increase gained from the CRIT RTE Boost status effect.
[*] Once you land a Critical hit, the status effect is removed.
[/list][table][tr][td][b]Effect Stack Stage[/b][/td][td][b]Effect[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td]Stage 1[/td][td]CRIT RTE +3[/td][/tr][tr][td]Stage 2[/td][td]CRIT RTE +10[/td][/tr][tr][td]Stage 3[/td][td]CRIT RTE +30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Stage 4[/td][td]CRIT RTE +100[/td][/tr][/table]

[b]Developer's Notes[/b]
[table][tr][td]In the previous utility improvements, certain values from Lann's CRIT RTE Boost were changed from the previous 22% to 15%. It was a fix related to the sentiment that Lann should be able to forgo 7% of CRIT RTE.
However, after the change above was applied, there were situations where the core skill 'Gliding Fury' was difficult to use, as CRIT RTE might not be applied properly in situations where your equipment was not ready yet.

This new status effect is to prevent this from happening, and make it so that the Gliding Fury skill can be used more smoothly even with a lack of CRIT RTE stats.
This change will have a greater effect on players who lack CRIT RTE than those who have enough, but we expect that raising the CRIT RTE stat to its maximum will still increase DPS in a meaningful way.[/td][/tr][/table]


[b]Lann - Twin Spears[/b]
[list]
[*] The dodge range will apply to its maximum 39 frames regardless of Spear Dash skill rank.
[*] Fixed an issue where you could not use Spear Dash in succession.
[*] Changed the amount of Stamina consumed when using Spear Dash.

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the 'Slashing High' status effect could not be obtained.

[b]Fiona - Long Hammer[/b]

[*] Fixed an issue where the attack range of Stigma Hammer does not change.
[*] The attack range of Stigma Hammer will now change based on the time spent building up power.

[list]

[*] Adjusted the SP consumption of Active: Gigantic Strength from 400 SP to 350 SP.

[*] Added information on Overheat to the skill description of Active: Hurricane

[list]

[*] Fixed the effect of Deft, the status effect obtained by using Strafe Shot.
[*] Removed the stacking stages of the status effect, and made fixes so that the previous Stage 3 effect applies immediately upon obtaining the status effect.
[*] Changed the information about Deft in the Strafe Shot skill description.
[*] Increased the SP gained when using Twister Kick and Gale Kick while you have the Deft status effect.
[/list][table][tr][td][b]Skill Name[/b][/td][td][b]Previous[/b][/td][td][b]After[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td]Twister Kick[/td][td]Recover 30 / 40 / 45 SP per Deft Stage[/td][td]Recove 50 SP[/td][/tr][tr][td]Gale Kick[/td][/tr][/table][list]

[*] You can briefly use the short distance you get knocked back if you press the Move Forward Shortcut Key at the time the arrow is fired.
[*] Otherwise, you will be pushed back the same distance as before.
[*] Made a fix so that your character moves backward 70% less when the Move Forward Shortcut Key is pressed at the same time Active: Ricochet Shot is fired after using Magnum.
[*] Otherwise, you will be pushed back the same distance as before.
[*] Fixed an issue where the fired arrow got lost when chaining Active: Ricochet Shot after using Magnum Stage 3 while close to a wall.
[*] Adjusted the frames in which the dodge hitbox takes effect when Dodge is used from 0-32 frames to 0-37 frames.
[*] Made a fix so that the dodge hitbox is applied for 0-31 frames when using Twister Kick.
[*] Adjusted the SP consumption of Active: Chain Link from the previous 250 to 0.
[*] Added the new status effect Chain Link CRIT RTE, through which the activation probability of Hunter's Eye is adjusted to 100% for 20 seconds when using Active: Chain Link.
[*] Changed the cooldown time of Active: Chain Link from 60 seconds to 120 seconds.
[*] Added information regarding the status effect in the Active: Chain Link skill description.
[*] Changed the Special Dodge Shortcut Key for Active: Dodge Grapple to the following.
[*] Fixed the skill preview video and status effect description according to the changes to the new shortcut key.[/list][table][tr][td][b]Previous[/b][/td][td][b]After[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td]Use the Dodge Shortcut Key right before Dodge Grapple ends[/td][td]Use the Kick Shortcut Key right before Dodge Grapple ends[/td][/tr][/table][list]
[*] Made a fix so that the Chain Link skill cannot have Waking Stone: Efficient SP applied, as the skill's SP consumption has been removed.
[*] If your existing character's Chain Link skill currently has the "Efficient SP" Waking Stone applied, the applied Waking Stone will be changed to Efficient SP (30) and the "awakening failure" state.
[*] It will be changed to an "awakening failure" state to prevent the skill's max awakening info from being removed if the skill's Waking Stone info is also removed.
[*] Also changed to the lowest rank's Efficient SP (30) so that there is no limit for applicable ranks if you switch to a different Skill Awakening Stone in the future.
[*] Based on the changes above, the following rewards will be distributed via mail to players who meet the distribution criteria:
[*] [Distribution Criteria] If "Waking Stone: Efficient SP" is applied to the Chain Link skill during the scheduled 4/22 (Thu) maintenance
[/list][table][tr][td][b]Item Name[/b][/td][td][b]Quantity[/b][/td][td][b]Tradability[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td]The "Waking Stone: Efficient SP" that was applied[/td][td]1[/td][td]Bound to Character[/td][/tr][tr][td]Skill Awakening Assuring Erg (40%)[/td][td]2[/td][/tr][tr][td]Skill Awakening Assuring Erg (20%)[/td][td]1[/td][/tr][tr][td]Skill Awakening Delimiter Erg (60%)[/td][td]1[/td][/tr][/table]
 

[b]Hurk - Teide[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the time it takes to fire all 6 shells when rapidly left-clicking after using Active: True Shot from approximately 6 seconds to approximately 3.5 seconds.
[*] Made improvements so that when using Reload Stance at least Rank F while all 8 rounds are loaded, all 8 rounds become Enhanced Bullets.
[*] Updated the Enhanced Bullet loading info in the Reload Stance skill description.
[*] The frames where Spinning Slash can offset enemies' attacks have been changed to the following. 
[/list][table][tr][td][b]Previous[/b][/td][td][b]Test Server[/b][/td][td][b]Official Server[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td]0 - 20 Frames[/td][td]0 - 55 Frames[/td][td]0 - 45 Frames[/td][/tr][/table]


[b]Lynn - Battleshade[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased the SP gain from Normal Attacks, Petal to the Metal, and Fight and Flight.
[/list][table][tr][td][b]Skill Name[/b][/td][td][b]Previous[/b][/td][td][b]After[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td]Normal Attack[/td][td]Gain 2 SP[/td][td]Gain 8 SP[/td][/tr][tr][td]Normal Attack 2x[/td][td]Gain 3 SP[/td][td]Gain 10 SP[/td][/tr][tr][td]Petal the the Metal[/td][td]Gain 25 SP[/td][td]Gain 35 SP[/td][/tr][tr][td]Fight and Flight[/td][td]Gain 10 SP[/td][td]Gain 15 SP[/td][/tr][/table][list]
[*] The attack range of Normal Attacks and Smashes below, as well as certain Active Skills, have been increased to the following.
[/list][table][tr][td][b]Skill Name[/b][/td][td][b]Range Increase[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td]Normal Attack x1[/td][td]+ 50%[/td][/tr][tr][td]Normal Attack x2[/td][/tr][tr][td]Normal Attack x3[/td][/tr][tr][td]Normal Attack x4[/td][/tr][tr][td]Petal to the Metal[/td][/tr][tr][td]Metal Blossom[/td][/tr][tr][td]Additional hits of Full Tilt Canopy and Spiked Ferrule after Fight and Flight[/td][/tr][tr][td]Flora Break[/td][/tr][tr][td]Additional hits of Full Tilt Canopy and Spiked Ferrule after Flora Break[/td][/tr][tr][td]Active: Iron Breeze[/td][/tr][tr][td]Active: Sudden Gust[/td][/tr][tr][td]Active: Paranormal Parasol[/td][td]+ 100%[/td][/tr][tr][td]Fight and Flight[/td][/tr][/table][list]

[*] Made a fix so that your character does not get knocked down even after being attacked upon unleashing the additional hits that follow Active: Flora Break, Full Tilt Canopy, and Spiked Ferrule.

[*] Changed the information regarding SP in the Active: Paranormal Parasol skill description. 
[*] Increased the damage of Active: Paranormal Parasol and Active: Iron Breeze by 50% compared to the previous official server. However, the first hit damage of Active: Iron Breeze has been decreased by 25%.
[*] Increased the damage of Active: Sudden Gust by 200% compared to the previous official server.
[*] Reduced the time needed for the hitbox to take effect after Active: Downpour of Death is used. ("After 70 frames" → "After 40 frames")
[*] Fixed the animation that rotated the character to face the opposite direction during Fight and Flight's final smash animation.
[*] Moves forward and deals damage while maintaining the direction that your character is facing. 
[*] You can change the direction in which the character moves by using the directional keys while the character is rotating during the Fight and Flight animation.
[*] Fixed the skill preview video based on the changes to the Fight and Flight skill animation.
[*] Made a fix so that Full Force can be activated when hitting an enemy with Fight and Flight.
[/list] 

[b]Developer's Notes[/b]
[table][tr][td]Active: Iron Breeze is a skill that can be used as a means of movement, and it consumes less SP than Active: Sudden Gust and has a shorter cooldown.
When comparing the current damage of the two skills, the damage of Active: Iron Breeze was unintentionally excessive, so we made adjustments to decrease it.
While making the adjustments above, we also increased the damage of Active: Sudden Gust so that there is not a significant change to the character's overall performance.[/td][/tr][/table]
 

[b]Arisha - Spellwhip[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed the frames in which the guard hitbox takes effect when using the A Battuta skill from 0-16 frames to 0-25 frames, based on the max rank.
[*] Fixed the chain timing from 0-15 frames (after Crescendo is used) to 0-25 frames, to allow for easier chaining of Prestissimo after Crescendo.
[*] Adjusted the chain timing to allow for easier chaining of A Battuta after Crescendo. ("After 25 frames" → "After 16 frames")
[*] Made a fix so that Mana Agrément can also be used after Prestissimo.
[*] Made a fix so that 10 STA is recovered after successfully attacking an enemy using the Mana Agrément skill.
[*] Made a fix so that 20 STA is recovered after successfully attacking an enemy using the Mana Agrément (Enhanced Attack) skill.
[*] Updated the Mana Agrément skill description based on these changes.
[*] Increased the hit range of Mana Capriccio by 33%.
[*] Made a fix so that Breathless Rush stacks don't decrease even after being attacked when the status effect is at 16 stacks or more.
[*] Made a fix so that MP is not consumed when using Accentato while Breathless Rush is at 20 stacks.
[*] Made a fix so that Breathless Rush gains stacks based on the number of times Active: Staccato Burst hits the enemy.
[*] The Breathless Rush status effect that's gained through Active: Staccato Burst can be stacked past 10, regardless of Mana Bis usage.
[*] Updated the Active: Staccato Burst skill description based on the changes.
[*] Made a fix so that stacks of Breathless Rush can still be obtained even after gaining 10 stacks from using Active: Fierce Rondo.
[*] Updated the information regarding stacks in the Active: Fierce Rondo skill description.
[*] Made a fix so that the skill Crescendo can be used immediately after the first hit of Stringendo Strike.
[*] Made a fix so that Crescendo cannot be chained from the third hit on. Instead, Marcato Rush can be used to chain after using Stringendo Strike.
[*] Crescendo can still chain during the first and second hits like before. 
[*] Fixed the dodge periods that take effect when using Mana Agrément after successfully blocking an enemy's attack with A Battuta. 
[/list][table][tr][td][b]Previous[/b][/td][td][b]After[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td]62 - 69 Frames[/td][td]0 - 39 Frames[/td][/tr][/table][list]

[*] The Mana Agrément that's chained while using Receding Interlude activates a Mana Agrément that's used when dodging.
[*] Made a fix so that the icon for the Breathless Rush status effect is displayed separately at the bottom of the boss monster's tenacity gauge.
[*] Fixed an issue where Breathless Rush, an important status effect for gameplay, couldn't be seen when the number of status effects applied to the character was above a certain amount.
[*] Now, the status effect is displayed in a separate area, and you can drag it to your preferred location.
[/list]

[b]Miri[/b]
[list]
[*] Slightly increased the time in which the guard hitbox takes effect upon your first and second hits of Parrying Attack.
[/list][table][tr][td][b]Hitbox[/b][/td][td][b]Previous[/b][/td][td][b]After[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td]First Hit's Guard Hitbox[/td][td]0 - 27 Frames[/td][td]0 - 30 Frames[/td][/tr][tr][td]Second Hit's Guard Hitbox[/td][td]0 - 27 Frames[/td][td]0 - 30 Frames[/td][/tr][/table][list]
[*] Changed the recovery time of when the Flamebreath gauge is entirely used up from 12 seconds to 7 seconds.
[*] Fixed the SP consumption of Active: Ancestral Garb from 300 to 200. 
[*] Fixed by reducing the Wyvern Magic status effect's stages from 5 to 3. Also made improvements so that getting hit won't reduce your stage.
[*] Made a fix so that releasing the absorbed energy from successful Parrying Attacks can be used at Wyvern Magic stage 1 instead of 3.
[/list][table][tr][td][b]Wyvern Magic Stage[/b][/td][td][b]Previous[/b][/td][td][b]After[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td]Stage 1[/td][td]No effect, not consumed even upon a successful Parrying Attack[/td][td]Gain 10 SP[/td][/tr][tr][td]Stage 2[/td][td]No effect, not consumed even upon a successful Parrying Attack[/td][td]Gain 35 SP[/td][/tr][tr][td]Stage 3[/td][td]Adds additional damage 3 times, adds 90 STA & 90 SP[/td][td]Gain 15 SP[/td][/tr][tr][td]Stage 4[/td][td]Adds additional damage 4 times, adds 120 STA & 120 SP[/td][td] [/td][/tr][tr][td]Stage 5[/td][td]Adds additional damage 5 times, adds 150 STA & 150 SP[/td][td] [/td][/tr][/table][list]
[*] Changed the Parrying Attack skill description based on the Wyvern Magic stage adjustments.
[*] Made the Active: Blazing Spine projectiles that fly towards enemies 3 times faster.
[/list]

[b]Kael[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased the max stage of the Brilliance status effect from 10 to 15.
[*] Added an effect that recovers 25 STA when hitting an enemy with Guardian's Blade: Counter.
[*] You do not recover stamina from attacks that use additional controls, only when you successfully hit an enemy with the first attack.
[*] Adjusted the stages of Guardian's Blade: Strike that chain after using each skill as the following.
[/list][table][tr][td][b]Skill Name[/b][/td][td][b]Previous[/b][/td][td][b]After[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td]Active: Resistance Unchained[/td][td]Third hit[/td][td]Fourth hit[/td][/tr][tr][td]Active: Low Flight[/td][td]Third hit[/td][td]Fourth hit[/td][/tr][tr][td]Active: Demos Uprising[/td][td]Third hit[/td][td]Fourth hit[/td][/tr][tr][td]Active: Rhythmic Radiance[/td][td]Third hit[/td][td]Fourth hit[/td][/tr][tr][td]Thunderbird Slash[/td][td]Second hit[/td][td]Third hit[/td][/tr][tr][td]Eagle Flight[/td][td]Second hit[/td][td]Third hit[/td][/tr][/table]
 

[b]Charon[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the final smash attack hit that led to Hex: Luchia would not occur when using Rune Spectrum while your ATT SPD was above a certain value.
[*] Adjusted the camera perspective available when determining Active: Moonlight's range, so a wider view can be seen while using it.
[*] Adjusted the camera location so that Active: Moonlight can be used from a field of vision that's wider than before.
[*] Adjusted the default aiming location when using Active: Moonlight.
[*] While previously adjusting the camera used when aiming, an issue was discovered where the default aiming location after the skill is cast was shifted to directly in front of the character, making it difficult to use. The location has now been restored to what it was previously.

[b]Neamhain[/b]
[list]
[*] Decreased the damage of the following skills.
[/list][table][tr][td][b]Skill Name[/b][/td][td][b]Damage Decrease[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td]Blink Pike[/td][td]- 10%[/td][/tr][tr][td]Rapid Pike[/td][/tr][tr][td]Gale Slash[/td][/tr][tr][td]Rapid Pierce[/td][/tr][tr][td]Ascension Slash[/td][/tr][tr][td]Smite the Wicked[/td][/tr][tr][td]Divine Slash[/td][td]- 18%[/td][/tr][tr][td]Divine Slash (Advent State)[/td][/tr][tr][td]Heaven Impact[/td][/tr][/table]

[list]
[*] The spring theme for the game's starting screen, Colhen, Rocheste, and Malina will end.
[*] Cherry blossom trees will no longer appear in the center of Colhen.
[*] The spring theme for the in-game event notifications will also end.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Added the Photo Studio emote to the Emote UI.

notes.title: Ver. 3.22 Update Note
notes.content:
Hello, this is the Vindictus team.
Below are the list of changes available after the version update on [b]March 25th, 2025.[/b]

[b]Table of Contents[/b]
[olist][*]Changes to Event Notifications[/*][*]Story Skip Function[/*][*]Temporary Guild Support[/*][*]In-Game Spring Seasonal Theme[/*][*]Special Spring Log-in Gift[/*][*]Bug Fix[/*][/olist]


[b][u]1. Changes to Event Notifications[/u][/b]
[list][*]The Event Notification UI has been improved into a calendar format.[/*][/list][list][*]
The new Event Notification calendar supports both schedules for current events and upcoming events.
[/*][/list][list][*][list][*]Upcoming events are subject to change / cancel before their release, depending on their circumstances.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]A new feature, 'Permanent Event Menu' has been added.[/*][/list][list][*][list][*]Events ongoing permanently can be viewed from the new menu.[/*][/list][/*][/list]

[b][u]2. Story Skip Function[/u][/b]
[list][*]The Story Skip function is now available.[/*][/list][list][*]A previous title, "Title: Rocheste Tourist" has been added to the Ancient Title Destiny Box.[/*][/list]

[b][u]3. Temporary Guild Support[/u][/b]
[list][*]From March 25th to April 29th, Guild House Dues will be discounted.[/*][/list][list][*][list][*]During the period, all Guild House Dues will have an additional 5% off. [/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][list][*]The discount will be applied to the following month.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]GP obtained from Guild Missions will be doubled during the support period.[/*][/list]

[b][u]4. In-game Spring Seasonal Theme[/u][/b]
[list][*]From March 25th to April 22nd, the in-game theme will be changed to Spring maps.[/*][/list][list][*]The main starting screen will change to spring seasonal theme.[/*][/list][list][*]Colhen / Rocheste / Malina are subject to change.[/*][/list][list][*][list][*]Desolate Malina will not be changed.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]When moving to Colhen / Rocheste, the loading screen will be changed to the spring theme.[/*][/list][list][*]The lobby loading screen before the Colhen quest departure will be changed to the spring theme.[/*][/list][list][*]New character Friendship lines have been added.[/*][/list]

[b][u]5. Special Spring Log-in Gift[/u][/b]
[list][*]From March 25th to April 22nd, upon logging in with a character Lv.1+ you will receive a "Dance of Flowers Effect Box" via mail.[/*][/list]

[b][Item Details][/b]
[table][tr][td][b]Item Name[/b][/td][td][b]Claimable Character[/b][/td][td][b]Expiration[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td]Dance of Flowers (30 Days)[/td][td]Female / Male[/td][td]30 days[/td][/tr][tr][td]Dance of Flowers (30 Days)[/td][td]Karok[/td][td]30 days[/td][/tr][tr][td]Dance of Flowers (30 Days)[/td][td]Hurk / Grimden[/td][td]30 days[/td][/tr][/table]

[u][b]6. Bug Fix[/b][/u]

[b][Battle][/b]
[list][*]
Fixed an issue where the enchant effect applying even in situations when you cannot use Artifacts, like when you are holding an item, aiming a secondary weapon, etc.
[/*][*]
Fixed an isssue where characters getting stuck when going up the hill after entering the battle region for "The One Who Protects the Altar."
[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the map brightness appears unnatural when entering the battle region for "The One Who Protects the Altar."[/*][/list][list][*]Fixed an issue where the light pillar effect did not show when obtaining "Uaithne Fragment: The Cursed Belt" in "Glutton's Banquet."[/*][/list][list][*]Fixed an issue where the light pillar effect did not show when obtaining an "Outfit Recipe Scroll" in a Special Dungeon.[/*][/list]

[b][Misc.][/b]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where the user could not obtain an AP 500 capsule upon completing the story 'Getaway.'[/*][/list][list][*]Fixed an issue where the story repeats itself from the beginning when selecting "No" for a Redeemers story branch.[/*][/list]


As always, we will do our best to provide you with a great gaming experience.
Thank you for supporting Vindictus!
