notes.title: [Letter from Allanon] Have a happy New Year in this year of the Blue Snake!
notes.content:
Hello, this is DEV Allanon.

 

It seems like just a few days ago we welcomed the new year of 2025, and soon a month will have passed.

I am sending you my New Year's greetings, even though they're late.

 

[b][New Character Neamhain and Golden Time Event][/b]

It hasn't been long since we introduced the new character Neamhain, the boss monster Gorbas of the Glutton's Banquet, and Golden Time.

You've given us a lot of feedback, suggestions, and recommendations, and we've carefully reviewed it all.

In order to resolve the inconvenient parts of Neamhain's character, we made an additional update yesterday, January 23rd. We will also check to see if any other inconveniences remain.

There were many concerns that Neamhain might have been over-tuned, but we decided to fix her by prioritizing playability and comfort.

If objective indicators show other adjustments are needed during future balance updates, we will approach them cautiously.

There was a lot of feedback and suggestions regarding Neamhain, but there was much more buzz regarding the Golden Time event.

There were voices of support for the Golden Time item rewards and many valuable comments on the event's change to a designated-day attendance check method.

We agree with each and every one of your opinions and believe they are valid. Based on the feedback and event data you have carefully written, we will consider ways to satisfy even more players in future Golden Time events.

 

[b][Mileage Shop][/b]

There were also many inquiries about the Mileage Shop.

We think the Mileage Shop, which we are planning on adding in the July or August update, could replace the NX Reward event.

When you purchase items with NX, you will receive a certain amount of mileage points, and these points can be used to purchase desired items at the Mileage Exchange Shop, which is always open.

It will include some of the outfits previously featured in the NX Reward event, along with the Bres, Eisen Ritter outfits, Wings, and Back Ornament items.

In addition to outfits, we will work on customizing the product list to provide more options for purchasing items, including NX items such as Enhancement Runes or Enchant Runes.

In fact, the most common inquiry about the Mileage Shop is about the commonization of exclusive hair.

The commonization of exclusive hair is an item prepared as a special benefit only available at the Mileage Shop. We plan to make hairstyles that can only be worn by specific characters available to all characters of the same gender.

Since Hurk, Grimden, and Karok have different body types from other male characters, we are reviewing whether their hair can be shared, and we will push forward in a direction where they can while preserving our original intentions as much as possible.

We have also confirmed the suggestion to proceed with the commonization of Exclusive Equipment etc., but please note that we are currently only proceeding with plans for hair.

 

[b][Recollection Crystal][/b]

We also reviewed the discontinuation of the Recollection Crystal, which many of you suggested.

The Recollection Crystals, which were to provide a chance to obtain outfits that you unfortunately missed, will no longer be provided.

We have made this decision in agreement with the feedback of many players who shared negative experiences, which goes against our original intention.

 

[b][Character Utility Improvements] [/b]

While opinions on Golden Time events, hair commonization, and Recollection Crystals tended to gather attention at certain points in time, the most consistent suggestions were for character utility improvements.

The first character utility improvement update of the year is currently in the works and targeted for release in March.

In March, we plan to resolve the unreasonable play structure as before, by slightly modifying several characters.

We plan to modify characters like Lynn using the Battleshade, Arisha using the Spellwhip, Fiona using the Long Hammer, Cestus Karok, Kael, Hurk using the Teide, and Kai using the Bow.

After the March update, the next update is expected to be around June.

We will start by focusing on improving Vella, who uses the Twin Swords and Twin Chainblades, and then sequentially work on characters that need a lot of improvement. 

We ask for your understanding from players who use Vella, and we will proceed meticulously to get good results.

 

We will prepare a detailed explanation of the schedule and the contents of the updates we're unable to introduce one by one in the DevTalk before the summer update.

That DevTalk is scheduled to be released around March, but if it is delayed, we will share our progress through DevComments.

 

As this is a meaningful year that began with meeting our players face-to-face, we will work even harder to become a Vindictus that always listens to our players' voices.

Have a happy New Year in this year of the Blue Snake!

 

And thank you!

 

[b]NOTICE[/b]
[list][*]The above information and schedule are based on the Korean server. [/*][*]Please note that this includes parts that have not yet been implemented, such as improvements to Neamhain and the new raid. [/*][/list]

notes.title: [Notice] Regarding Planned Changes to VIP Premium Purple Storm Aurora Items
notes.content:
Hello, this is Vindictus.

We would like to provide prior notice regarding modifications to the Aurora Effect Destiny Box, which was distributed as part of the 2024 NX Reward Event.

 

[b][Notice Details][/b]

It has been confirmed that the VIP Premium Purple Storm Aurora effect displayed in-game differs slightly from the effect described in the 2024 NX Reward Event announcement.

The three VIP Premium Aurora effects showcased on the event page were recorded during the development process.

During the creation of the VIP Premium Purple Storm Aurora, the blinking effect, which appears during the reactivation of the effect, was deemed unnatural.

To achieve a smoother and more natural visual effect, adjustments were made, resulting in the current Flashing Type (VIP Premium Purple Storm Aurora - Pulsing Variant).

 

However, as the current VIP Premium Purple Storm Aurora (Pulsing Variant) was provided without adequate explanation beforehand, we plan to resolve this issue by adding a VIP Premium Purple Storm Aurora (Steady Variant) option to the box contents.

This will allow players who selected the VIP Premium Purple Storm Aurora effect to choose the type they prefer and prevent any inconvenience.

The details are as follows:

notes.title: [INTRO] Neamhain
notes.content:
[b][img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1304/800x450.png[/img][/b]

 

[b][ABOUT][/b]

The Reflection Resisting Fate

 

Neamhain is an unknown mercenary with the same name as a goddess.

She claims she is a Holy Knight of Orkha, but everyone thinks her somewhat strange.

On the outside, she appears cold and haughty, but she often startles others with her unexpected behavior.

There seems to be an untold story behind her stubborn, or even unreasonable behavior.

 

Neamhain uses a long spear called the Holy Lance and performs various actions with magic unique to the Holy Knights.

She can use the Divinity acquired during attacking and defending to deliver a powerful blow, and also infuse her body with the power of the gods to strengthen her body for a certain period of time.

 

[b][SCREENSHOTS][/b]

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1300/character_25_01.jpg[/img]

 

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1301/character_25_02.jpg[/img]

[b][[/b][url=https://youtu.be/14G9BDL4v6U][b]GAMEPLAY TRAILER[/b][/url][b]][/b]

Click above for the trailer.

 

[b][EXCLUSIVE SKILLS][/b]

Click the skill name to check Neamhain's Exclusive Skills.

 

[url=https://youtu.be/HQ2j_E_YUzI][b]Embrace Divinity[/b][/url]

This is a skill that can be used when all Divinities have been gathered, and when fully charged, it can be chained with Divine Slash.

 

[url=https://youtu.be/uoWR0TECSKo][b]Active: Ethereal Wave[/b][/url]

This is a skill that grants the Flame of Thought status effect when attacking successfully.

Flame of Thought increases final damage by 5% for a set duration.

 

[url=https://youtu.be/ajdhHqreZ-w][b]Active: Gemini Spiral[/b][/url]

This is a skill in which you leap into the air and rapidly spin forward to deliver multiple attacks.

During the spinning attack, you can defend against enemy attacks and gain Divinity if you successfully defend.

 

[url=https://youtu.be/VZ4Imcday2Q][b]Active: Holy Vessel[/b][/url]

Strengthens yourself with the power of god for a set duration.

Restores HP and increases Action Speed and Damage Reduction for a set duration.

The charging time of Embrace Divinity has been slightly reduced, allowing for a quick chain to Divine Slash.

notes.title: [CMTY] Standard Player Guide Event
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1337/steam_cover_img_800x450.jpg[/img]

Event Period: 1/21/2025 (Tue, after weekly maintenance) - 2/11/2025 (Tue, before weekly maintenance)

 
[b]How to Participate[/b]
You can either:A) Share small, personal tips to playing a specific character[list][*]Share tips you'd like to give to new mercenaries[/*][*]Any relevant piece of knowledge, short walkthrough or guides[/*][/list][u][/u]B) Share a detailed guide or walkthrough of mastering a specific character[list][*]Specific and detailed information on how to master the character in question[/*][*]A well-made and useful guide for newcomers to Vindictus[/*][/list]
 
[list][*][u][/u]Participation is not limited to in-game battle. Any relevant information to the character's play experience is eligible.[list][*](ex. places good to take screenshots for this character, How to move faster, Places to farm specific items that is needed, etc.)[/*][/list][/*][/list]
 

[u][/u][b]Title format[/b]
[list][*][Character in question] Title of Guide[list][*]ex. [Belle] Basic combos in battle[/*][/list][/*][/list][u][/u][u][/u][b]Must include in the guide[/b][list][*]The Character to Guide through (You must add this to the title as well)[/*][*]Your In-Game Character Name[/*][*]Your Server[/*][*]Your Participation Content[/*][/list][u][/u][u][/u][b]Rewards[/b][list][*]Participation Reward
[list][*]In-game limited title[u] [/u]'GUIDEWRIGHT'[/*][/list][/*][/list][u][/u][u][/u][b]Special Reward[/b][list][*]To the top guide per character: Discord Community Role[u] [/u]'Best Teacher'[/*][*]To the top 4 participants:[u] [/u]NX 100,000[u] [/u]x 4 Mercenaries (NA+EU)[/*][/list][u][/u][u][/u][b]Please Note[/b][list][*]The top four participants will be decided by Nexon Staff[/*][*]Unfair, irrelevant participation or participation with other people's work will not be taken into count[/*][*]There is no minimum required length to participation, and post length does not have correlation to scoring[/*][*]All guides must be up to date[/*][*]All types of media, including plain text, images, videos, GIFs, etc. are allowed to use in the guide[/*][*]All types of format, including Powerpoint, PDFs, etc. are allowed to write the guide[/*][*]All guides, relevant media and files must be posted on Discord (External URLs to a different site is not allowed, except YouTube)[/*][*]All participating guides may be used by Nexon[/*][*]You may participate in multiple characters, but you will not be rewarded more than once[/*][*]Winners will be announced and rewarded within February[/*][*]Upon announcement, additional procedures will take place for the NX rewards[/*][*]If the winner does not respond within a set period of time, you will not be able to receive your reward[/*][/list]

notes.title: [EVENT] Shayla's Gathering Dungeon Event!!!
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1333/staem_cover_img_800x450.jpg[/img]

Event Schedule: 1/21/2025 - 2/25/2025
[list][*]per-Character event for those Lv. 70 or higher[/*][/list]
 

1) When you log in with a character at Lv. 70+ during the event, 'Gathering Dungeon Entry Ticket' x2 will arrive in the Mailbox (per Character).
[list][*]Mailed to characters below Lv. 70 if they reach Lv. 70[/*][*]Entry Tickets expire on 2/25/2025 7 AM UTC[/*][/list]

[list][*]Drops Blue Gathering Essence on M/W/F, Red Gathering Essence on T/Th/S, and both on Sunday     [/*][/list]

notes.title: Neamhain: The Holy Knight of Conviction
notes.content:
Hello! This is the Vindictus team.

Today we're introducing the [b]26th[/b] hero of Vindictus, [b]Neamhain.[/b]

 

Neamhain is a female character who wields the [b]Holy Lance[/b]. 

 

The Holy Lance is a weapon characterized by a sharp spearhead and a long handle, and is designed to allow the handle to be folded or unfolded depending on the situation. 

Neamhain can use the Holy Lance to perform actions that combine with magic,

creating powerful strikes that unleash Divinity. 

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1305/20250108024505430.jpg[/img]

[b](Neamhain with Holy Lance)[/b]

 
[list][*][b]Combat Style with the Magic of the Holy Knights[/b][/*][/list]
Neamhain uses the Holy Knight's magic to summon a shield to defend against enemy attacks.

Upon defending successfully, you can counterattack with [b]Counter Slash[/b].

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1306/2025010802480379.jpg[/img]

[b](Neamhain blocking enemy's attack)[/b]

 

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1307/2025010802484334.jpg[/img]

[b](Counterattacking Neamhain)[/b]

 
[list][*][b]Powerful Strike Releases Divinity[/b][/*][/list]
Full divinity can be contained in the Holy Lance through [b]Embrace Divinity[/b].

When [b]Embrace Divinity[/b] is fully charged, you can use [b]Divine Slash[/b].

[b]Divine Slash[/b] releases the divinity contained in the Holy Lance all at once, delivering a powerful blow.

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1308/20250108024911198.jpg[/img]

When enhanced, your HP is restored, and you move more swiftly.

Additionally, the charge duration of [b]Embrace Divinity[/b] is reduced, allowing you to chain [b]Divine Slash[/b] more quickly.

notes.title: [STORY] Neamhain
notes.content:
The Story of Neamhain: The Reflection Resisting Fate

 

"Why do we exist?"

 

It was the first question, the first desire. Countless reflections flowed through space and time into the red sea... and the goddess here was drowning in an endless agony.

 

Her heart became as tainted as the waters, in this sea that she considered her cradle. A tear ran down her cheek, and despite being alone, she could not hide her embarrassment at the display of emotion. She was supposed to be past such things, now. The recent encounter with her forgotten self had filled her with hatred and hostility, which only served to drive her into a deeper confusion.

 

"This is not me. Then who...?"

 

She was overcome and writhed in agony, almost collapsing into the churning waters. She could not hold back the urge to vomit. She forced herself to reject thoughts, memories, feelings... They were only getting the way of the task she was divinely ordained to perform. These were, in turn, quietly swallowed by the waves all around her.

 

The goddess finally stood tall, wiping her mouth on her sleeve and appearing far more composed. She raised a quizzical eyebrow, unsure of what she had been doing just moments before. Yet the details mattered not, for she had work to do.

 

Neamhain smiled, extending her metallic wings as she rose from the red waters and into the pitch-black skies.

 

Yet memories and morals cannot be so easily swept aside.

 

So it was that the Sea of Reflection echoed her sentiments, asking that discarded reflection of humanity...

 

"Why do we exist?"

 

It spoke to a humble memory from a more innocent time, another Neamhain before she was ever elevated to godhood. This version also did not know why she existed, so when asked, she flowed toward the coastline, as if in a dream.

 

To seek the answer to that question.

 

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1294/img_story_neamhain_01.jpg[/img]

 

"Maybe... the goddess has abandoned us..."

 

"On the shore of Neimheadh, a young boy thought of his sister. It was supposed to be both of them, together, standing here. It was supposed to be fearful but exciting. Instead, all he had was regret and a tough task meant for two.

 

Steadying himself with a deep breath, he looked around as discreetly as he could. No one seemed to be around, but one could never be too careful here. Deciding that it was now or never, the boy reached down to remove something hidden in the sand: a rope, leading out into the sea. He began hauling it in as quickly as he could, eventually revealing a small, submerged boat. Cold moonlight appeared to be the only witness to this act, which was fortunate... If anyone else saw what he was up to, it would surely mean his death."

 

That was because this child was a Nemedian, the lowest caste in Neimheadh. Though serving the same god that all the Fomors did, he was practically treated as slave labor, and this night could be his only chance at ever escaping that life. Thoughts of his sister first slowed, then hastened his movements. Hiding in other, human lands was her idea, and it was now his only chance.

 

"He had finally hauled in enough of the skiff to set off when he suddenly froze. Against the darkness, an even darker figure rose from the waves and approached him.

 

He cursed under his breath, calling himself a fool for not being even more careful. He hadn't thought to check the very waters for someone spying on him. Escape was not an option; all of his worldly possessions were stowed in the boat, and at this point, they'd ferret him out eventually."

 

"W-who goes there?" he demanded, his attempt at sounding like a guard undercut by his age. He was shocked to see that the figure actually looked human, and what he had assumed was a monstrous shape was due to her stumbling over and bracing herself weakly against her lance. He could swear he had seen wings behind her, but maybe it had just been a trick of the moonlight.

 

The woman wobbled and answered him slowly, her voice breaking before collapsing to the white sands.

 

"N-Neamhain..."

 

He stared down at the unconscious woman with no little apprehension. First, he had questioned his eyes, but now he couldn't believe his ears. To name your child—or style yourself—after a goddess of Neimheadh was the height of blasphemy. Still, at least he wasn't the one in trouble; she didn't look like one of the local guards, and they wouldn't be in the habit of sacrilege, anyway.

 

She was still breathing, but that wouldn't last for long if she was caught. The boy thought about launching his boat right then and there... but his sister wouldn't have ever forgiven him if she had still been around.

 

Cursing again, he scuttled his boat and his plans, at least for now. He then half-lifted and half-dragged the stranger across the sandy beach.

 

"Ugh," he groaned. "Lady, you're heavy!"

 

He had to stop several times to catch his breath, but he eventually got them both to his sea cave. He dragged the woman inside and laid his coat over her until he could get a fire going.

 

"I can't believe I'm doing this..."

 

He sat down next to her, and his exhaustion quickly overtook him.

 

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1295/img_story_neamhain_02.jpg[/img]

 

The woman eventually woke up, gasping, as if struggling for air. She felt like she'd been drowning in her dream. As she took in her unfamiliar surroundings, however, her confusion was quickly replaced wariness.

 

She found eyes peering at her from the darkness. She started to reach for her weapon before realizing that this was the boy that she had briefly seen on the shore. What she could make of his expression was unreadable, but he felt as tense as a cornered wolf.

 

"You awake?" he asked her bluntly.

 

"M-maybe? I feel like... I've been dreaming for so long." She shook her head, trying to clear the cobwebs, before realizing that she was having trouble remembering much at all. "And who are you?"

 

"I'm Neit."

 

That wasn't enough of an answer to her inquiry, but the last thing she wanted to do was pester a child. Whatever situation she had found herself in, it was her own burden to arise from.

 

...How did she get here, anyway?

 

The beach. When and how had she fallen into the sea? Each time she tried to grasp a memory, it was as water slipping through her fingers, a wave returning to the Sea of Reflection. Perhaps she had hit her head. Yes, that was it. She must have been in a battle, or perhaps a storm.

 

For now, she could only nod slowly in response.

 

"I've you to thank then, Neit. I am called Neamhain."

 

The child had a strange expression on his face. A cornered wolf who suddenly found his captor distasteful.

 

"You're human," he offered, as much a statement as a question. "Well, you don't have to worry. We're in my hideout. There are a lot of small caves on the Neimheadh coast, but this one's the best."

 

"...Neimheadh." She attempted the unfamiliar name, praying to suppress a sudden fear that sprung unbidden to her mind. It wasn't merely that she didn't recognize it. The name itself felt so distant and lonely that it didn't even feel real to her.

 

"I... see. I'm not quite sure where... The last thing I remember, I was back in Orkha," she admitted. "Glorious Orkha. I wasn't out on a crusade, was I? Hmm..." Neit simply looked at her strangely.

 

"Never heard of that place."

 

"What?" she smiled. "Everyone's heard of Orkha. It's the greatest civilization that has ever been built. Oh, I know. Surely, you've heard of the Holy Knights? We're the ones that use Holy Lances, such as this. Our legend has spread far and wide," she grinned, falling short of the humility that she sought.

 

"Nope," Neit shook his head emphatically. "I've never heard of any of those."

 

Neamhain furrowed her brow. She must have found herself in a truly backwater place if they didn't raise their children with such basic concepts, or respect for the divinity. Perhaps she had traveled here to proselytize to them? Volunteering as a missionary could make sense, at least. Attempts to remember anything continued to elude her.

 

Neit's voice was finally able to rouse her from her reverie.

 

"I'd try to take it easy. You're in safe hands, I promise. Morrighan is the only god that humans worship, anyway, and I'm sure she'll protect you, too."

 

Morrighan? What blasphemy was this? The syllables felt strange to Neamhain; that was definitely no goddess that she had ever heard of. Why, her own god would—

 

The woman suddenly found it very hard to breathe. She was a Holy Knight, yet could not remember anything about the deity she served. Their domain, their name, even their gender... Other than the title "Savior" ringing through her thoughts, no other trace remained. Neamhain could not fathom how such a travesty could come to pass. She could still feel the divine magics within her, so she at least took comfort in the knowledge that her god had not forgotten her. It was still enough for a deep shame to encompass her.

 

She suddenly felt very alone.

 

Unaware of all this, Neit tossed some more driftwood into the campfire and pulled a small, blackened lump from the flames. Neamhain caught a savory scent and realized just how hungry she was.

 

"Here, have a potato. Hey, be careful! Don't burn yourself."

 

She looked down at the strange thing she held. Brown and white were visible through the seared crust. She chanced a tentative bite.

 

The flavor was incredible. It was plain, but comforting. The foreign cuisine offered solace in its simplicity. Enjoying its humble taste brought about the first quiet moment the Holy Knight had experienced in... well, she wasn't quite sure how long.

 

"Potato, you say? Miraculous! I'd really like to take some back to Orkha with me," she said earnestly. "These are truly a blessing."

 

The boy only nodded gruffly and continued peeling potatoes. Neamhain ate several more, her appetite not sated until the fire burned low, casting long, dancing shadows along the cave wall.

 

She began describing her homeland to Neit, extoling the virtues of Orkha and the responsibilities of her religious order. Though standoffish at first, it wasn't long before the boy became enraptured by the tales.

 

"...but on a clear day, you can hear the church bells all the way past the gate, and there's this wonderful incense that's carried on the breeze."

 

"And everyone's actually happy there? Wow," he grinned. "A city like that sounds amazing."

 

"It's truly awe-inspiring." She was grateful that she still had these precious memories, at least. Who knows how far back this amnesia could have extended?

 

"Oh... Forgive me. Here I am, waxing poetic, and not even giving you a chance to speak."

 

"It’s okay. I liked it." Neit suddenly got up, smiling wryly. "I’ll be back... Someone ate all the potatoes."

 

"You're not going out now, surely?" she asked in surprise. "At this late hour?"

 

"I'm just going to dig up some more," Neit muttered.

 

"Then I'll go with you," she offered. "I want to see how potatoes grow underground, anyway."

 

The moment she attempted to stand, though, her legs gave out from beneath her and she collapsed into the soft sand of the cave. It seemed the spirit was willing, but the flesh was weak.

 

"Just wait here," Neit said as he left her. He attempted to sound far older and wiser than he was, but the worry was clear on his face.

 

So Neamhain remained alone in the cave, listening to the crackling choir of the dying fire. She tried to accept that her memories were gone, for now at least, and that her present circumstances were far from ideal. She knew that as soon as she was healthy enough, she would have to determine what the fastest route back to Orkha was.

 

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1296/img_story_neamhain_03.jpg[/img]

 

 

Neit came with the dawn, carrying a burlap sack of potatoes. He also carried numerous scratches, a few of which would most certainly scar.

 

"Oh! Are potatoes this difficult to uproot?" The doubt was clear in Neamhain's voice, but Neit just shrugged it off with a grin.

 

"It was just a little darker out there than I realized, is all. It's no big deal."

 

"Neit," she said gently, "these bodies are a gift to us from the divine, and they would not want us to damage them unduly. They would prefer we do our tasks carefully rather than recklessly..."

 

Neit laughed loudly at that, though she wasn't sure why. The boy practically had an armored exterior.

 

Yet over the next few days, as Neamhain got to know him. he turned out to be a caring kid. He even stayed in the cave with her until she was able to move around on her own again.

 

While cooking some more potatoes, he appeared lost in thought.

 

"...I think the gods must not exist."

 

"Oh!" Neamhain exclaimed. "Neit, you mustn’t say such things! They're always looking out for us."

 

The boy only scoffed. "Then why would they do this with my life? It's like one trial after another. If there are gods out there, then maybe we'd all be better off without them." He cast his eyes down."

 

The Holy Knight wasn't sure what to say. Chastising a child seemed wrong, and it didn't strike her as being a successful tactic, either.

 

"...Neit, why don't you come to Orkha with me? The deity I... serve is far kinder than the ones here, I can promise you that."

 

"That's good for you, but there's no god looking out for me."

 

She had only known Neit a short time, but Neamhain had never seen the child distraught before. It affected her greatly.

 

He seemed to look up at her admiringly, despite his sorrow. She was making progress, at least. The knight caught a glimpse of his necklace, and gestured towards it, hoping to change the subject.

 

"It's my sister's. Um... it was."

 

"Was?"

 

"She's dead," was his only response. The lack of emotion seemed practiced.

 

"I'm so sorry..."

 

The two lapsed into a long silence. There wasn't anything either could say that would make that situation better. When Neit eventually did speak, he struggled to find the right words.

 

"My sister wanted to... escape from Neimheadh. We thought we were so careful with our plan, too... for all the good it did. Damn this place."

 

It had never occurred to the Holy Knight before now that home might not be someplace that everyone always yearned to return to. The thought of it being a prison, or a form of hell, was quite beyond her own experience.

 

It broke her heart to behold. She decided that the boy must come with her to Orkha. She was sure that she was being entrusted with his safety, a mission sent by divine will.

 

"Whoa, not yet!" Neit said. "You still need to recover."

 

Days passed, with the woman slowly recovering and the boy keeping his vigil over her. Each night, Neit would leave to gather more potatoes, and each morning he came back with fresh wounds.

 

Until the morning that he didn't return.

 

Neamhain was instantly on guard. Something about Neit's story hadn't been adding up, but now she was genuinely worried for his safety. The boy going missing was enough to give strength to limbs that still asked for rest, and she was already out of the cave, lance in hand, before she had time to dwell on the possible consequences.

 

A cold wind began to rustle through the dense forest, quickening her steps. She might have been dealing with some memory problems, but she acutely remembered not caring for the cold. She also recalled protecting pilgrims and defending Orkha's borders, which taught her a few helpful tricks for tracking. She grimaced when the furtive footprints of a child were eventually met by something far more monstrous.

 

She finally came upon a rough-hewn fortification. There, a line of weary, sickly Nemedians carried heavy loads, while a goblin overseer shouted over the crack of his whip. These poor people looked human to Neamhain, and she could not imagine why they would be so willing to take this abuse.

 

She finally found Neit... just as the whip found his back, lashing streaks of red against the wall.

 

"Neit?!"

 

"In an instant Neamhain was at his side, her Holy Lance impaled through the overseer's chest. His scream was only met by her narrowed eyes. 

 

When the other goblins nearby rushed to surround her, she ripped her lance sideways through the overseer as if he was made of tattered parchment. The Holy Knight looked down her nose at these villains, with a stature and dismissiveness that only the truly devout can bring to bear. 

 

The Nemedians began to flee, but for now Neamhain was focused on protecting Neit.

 

She caught his gaze, but he seemed less than pleased.

 

"What are you doing here? It was safe in the cave," he managed weakly, as a mob of goblins rushed at them from all directions.

 

From a distance, one might only see flashes of dawn light in the early morning, dispelling the shadows of night. The truth was a far grimmer spectacle, as Neamhain ruthlessly skewered and slaughtered every goblin that dared approach them.

 

She'd slain heretics and zealots before, so she was well-accustomed to opponents with no seeming limit to their morale, but she couldn't imagine what drove these goblins to keep coming. They seemed to have a searing, fanatical hatred of her very humanity. What could cause such fervor? Neamhain held her own for a time, but she was not yet back to full strength, and the situation was grim.

 

Neit did the only thing he could. He prayed.

 

In answer, a burst of brilliant light shot out from behind Neamhain in the shape of glorious wings. They sheltered the boy, blocking the feeble forged weaponry of the goblins. The resplendent sight overwhelmed his senses.

 

The light emanating from Neamhain gathered into her Holy Lance, glowing with pristine purpose unsullied by mortal concerns. Neit could not be sure if the blessed weapon punctured a hole in the fabric of the very universe, or if Neamhain merely pointed at a spot in mid-air that her god then touched with a divine hand, but whatever the reason, an otherworldly portal suddenly tore reality asunder. From its unfathomable expanse flew forth a rain of magical Holy Lances towards the oncoming goblin horde.

 

By the time the holy light finally faded away, only Neamhain of Orkha and her young friend remained amidst a sea of goblin corpses.

 

"I hereby consecrate this ground in the name of the Savior." It took a moment for Neamhain to remember herself. She rushed over to Neit's side, lifting the helpless boy into her arms.

 

"Neamhain, you were amazing! Y-you're... her, right? The goddess?"

 

She choked up, at a loss for what to say. This latest round of torture was particularly brutal, and it was clear these were the last words the poor boy was ever going to hear, so she wanted to give him comfort... but she was merely an instrument of her savior. Any name she might share with this false idol was just a coincidence. Besides, if she really was one of the divine, she'd be able to save him. It felt like the heavens had a different plan in mind.

 

"Neit, I..."

 

The boy shuddered in her arms as he gasped for breath, wracked with pain. He still attempted to smile.

 

"I stole... the potatoes," he managed through ragged breaths. "You c-can't stay here... Not even you. Fly away... Maybe to the human l-lands. This place c-can't be saved... Orkha s-sounded nice. Is it paradise? Is t-that what you call it? Wish I c-could have seen it..."

 

With the last of his strength, he pressed a shaking hand into hers. His sister's necklace felt as cold as the child's body now did.

 

"Neit! Stay with me, Neit!"

 

Neamhain's scream echoed along the coastline, every cave a choir, every wave a cruel reflection.

 

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1297/img_story_neamhain_04.jpg[/img]

 

When she could finally push through her grief, the Holy Knight left on her longest journey yet. She set off for her home, Orkha, with only her lance and Neit's necklace. It was some small way to bring him on the journey, and getting the necklace blessed by her savior could ensure that he wouldn't suffer in the afterlife.

 

The entire journey soon proved to be bound by suffering, but she took each painful moment as a lesson given to her by the divine. It took several seasons for her penitent steps to find purchase in the soil of human lands. There, she was met with another sort of test.

 

"I beg your pardon, miss, but as a well-traveled cartographer I think I'd know if a land named Orkha existed."

 

Neamhain felt the frown lines of her scowl chisel further into her countenance with every inquiry. It wasn't merely these lands that were unfamiliar to her. Everything from the fashion to the agricultural level was different. She even bore witness to their strange firearms that belched smoke, killing invisibly from great distances like some demonic presence.

 

A terrible sinking feeling grew within her, as if she was drowning in a deep sea with no hope of reaching the surface... and everywhere she turned were people mentioning that false deity "Morrighan," or even this other "Neamhain." It seemed a terribly cruel joke to a devout Holy Knight that could no longer remember her own savior. Sometimes she would clench on to Neit's necklace so tightly that she bled.

 

She also learned of a desperate war between humanity and the Fomors. Danger and adversity were everywhere.

 

She was not used to relying on others, but her sacred order never had any need of gold. They required little, and what was needed was provided. She'd never carried a belt pouch before, yet now it seemed that everything catered to coin. The only reliable way she found to keep moving forward was to take on mercenary work, and she prayed to her unknown savior that each day she would end up where she was needed.

 

"I won't fail, Neit. I will find Orkha. I will get stronger. I'm just... oh! So hungry!"

 

The wandering knight came upon a small town in the countryside. She sat down heavily outside of an inn, exhaustion and hunger taking their toll. She patted around in vain for coins she knew weren't there.

 

Her fond memories of the potatoes that Neit had first cooked for her took root, and it was a long moment before she realized the aroma was real, and coming from nearby. The innkeeper, an older gentleman, was standing before her with a basket of baked potatoes.

 

"Well you look like you've had a long journey," he said kindly, holding out one to her. Neamhain took the potato with both hands, reverently. She still could not remember her savior, but they were still providing for her.

 

"Looks like you've seen your share of trouble, but a place like this has more than it can handle. Someone like you could make a big difference, and put some coin in your purse, besides." He watched her with soft concern as he cleaned his worn glasses. "The Crimson Blades mercenary company always looks after us, and they're located just next door."

 

"The Crimson Blades? Hmm, I see..."

She had finished her potato more quickly than she'd realized, but it did wonders for her fatigue. She trudged to the office and knocked on its door. The divine were leading her somewhere once again. Whatever that path, Neamhain was ready to move forward along it. She would serve where she was needed, and when the time was right, she would be guided back to glorious Orkha and her savior.

 

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1298/img_story_neamhain_05.jpg[/img]

[b][ABOUT][/b]

The Reflection Resisting Fate

 

Neamhain is an unknown mercenary with the same name as a goddess.

She claims she is a Holy Knight of Orkha, but everyone thinks her somewhat strange.

On the outside, she appears cold and haughty, but she often startles others with her unexpected behavior.

There seems to be an untold story behind her stubborn, or even unreasonable behavior.

 

Neamhain uses a long spear called the Holy Lance and performs various actions with magic unique to the Holy Knights.

She can use the Divinity acquired during attacking and defending to deliver a powerful blow, and also infuse her body with the power of the gods to strengthen her body for a certain period of time.

This is a skill that can be used when all Divinities have been gathered, and when fully charged, it can be chained with Divine Slash.

 

[url=https://youtu.be/uoWR0TECSKo][b]Active: Ethereal Wave[/b][/url]

This is a skill that grants the Flame of Thought status effect when attacking successfully.

Flame of Thought increases final damage by 5% for a set duration.

 

[url=https://youtu.be/ajdhHqreZ-w][b]Active: Gemini Spiral[/b][/url]

This is a skill in which you leap into the air and rapidly spin forward to deliver multiple attacks.

During the spinning attack, you can defend against enemy attacks and gain Divinity if you successfully defend.

Strengthens yourself with the power of god for a set duration.

Restores HP and increases Action Speed and Damage Reduction for a set duration.

The charging time of Embrace Divinity has been slightly reduced, allowing for a quick chain to Divine Slash.

notes.title: [CMTY] GM COIN S4: It’s a Gift!
notes.content:
[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1806/gm_coin_800x450.png[/img]

Event Period: December 17th - January 21st

 

Another year is coming to an end.

Won’t it be nice to prepare a small gift for someone you care for? 

…And won’t it be better if that gift’s something they'll NEVER EXPECT?

 

Show us what you've got in your inventory, that can be the weirdest, and not-so-useful present to someone that comes to your mind!

 

[b]How to participate[/b]:

From your inventory, choose an item that you would want to gift to someone.
The item should be something that when gifted, they will not be able to find a decent use for. (In other words, literally an 'useless' gift)

The person to receive the gift can be anyone. From your close friends or family, or a NPC in game, even monsters or bosses. The item too, does not have to be technically tradeable.
The key is 'choosing a weird gift.'

Share the item on our official discord with followings below:
[list][*]Server:[/*][*]The item you'd like to present:[/*][*]Why you chose that item: [/*][/list]
 

[b]Rewards:[/b]

If over 60 people participate, a coupon code containing 15 GM Coins will be revealed.

Otherwise, it will be exclusively disclosed to participants.Plus, from each server(NA/EU), two best participants will be chosen;

They will be given a special reward of extra 10 more GM Coins!

 

[b]Please Note:[/b]
[list][*]Each person can only participate once.[/*][*]Rewards will be given during maintenance on January 21st.[/*][*]Irrelevant posts, Posts not following the given format, or participation with other people's work will not be counted.[/*][*]All Submittions may be used in our official social accounts.[/*][*]Top 2 participants per server will be decided by Nexon Staff.[/*][/list]

notes.title: [Letter from Allanon] October Developer's Notes
notes.content:
[i][The contents in the Developer Notes are based on Korea Service Schedule, Overseas Updates will follow regional timelines] [/i]

   

Dear Mercenaries,

This is DEV Allanon, director of Vindictus. 

  

Today, I’d like to share some exciting updates for the winter season that you might be curious about.  

During the upcoming winter season, we are aiming to update the below sequentially. And will elaborate the current development status one by one.    

[list]
[*] Character Growth Section Renewal  
[*] The 3rd Space Time Distortion: The Watcher’s Temple  
[*] 26th New Hero Update  
[/list]

  

[b][Character Growth Section Renewal]   
[/b]
The Character Growth Section Renewal is scheduled for November.    

Since there will be some significant changes to familiar gameplay patterns, I’d like to highlight the key aspects that will change, as outlined in this October DEV Note: 







[b]1. Story Progression Process:  
[/b]
Stories that can be considered as tutorial will be excluded from the main story line, allowing players to focus solely on the main story of Vindictus.  

Players can choose to skip story dialogues; those who opt to skip will no longer need to click through each dialogue to proceed.

However, some dialogues may not offer the skip option. Even so, we’re working to minimize the time required for story progression. 







[b]2. Shortened Battle Progress:  
[/b]
After skipping the story, players can jump directly to boss battles, bypassing regular monster battles, which will streamline progression and reduce combat time.

I hope this renewal will create a smoother playing experience with more efficient paths and shorter battles.

To avoid making boss battles too quick or mechanical, I also plan to adjust the balance of boss monsters to enhance the leveling experience and deliver enjoyable action gameplay. 

  




[b]3. Revised Rewards in Growth Phase:  
[/b]
We plan to reduce the amount of gold earned from battles and story completions, replacing lower-value items with items essential for growth.

Equipment, AP, fatigue potions, and other necessities will be provided abundantly in the growth section, supporting players in preparing for raid battles through the main storyline. To offset the reduced gold, various missions and an adjustment in the cost of level 110 enhancements will help maintain smooth progression. 

  




[b]4. Renewed Guide System:  
[/b]
As character growth paths change, the guide system will be updated accordingly.

Play guide missions can now be completed regardless of stage, and missions such as redeemer clearance requirements will be adjusted to match the faster growth pace.  

  




Additionally, minor updates will be made, such as advancing key skills acquisition times for certain characters, increasing Red Moon’s Energy Battle EXP, and so on. We will continue to monitor feedback from players on these changes. 

  




[b][Space Time Distortion: The Watcher’s Temple]  
[/b]
The 3rd Space-Time Distortion, The Watcher’s Temple, is scheduled for November.

The test server will open on November 6th, with the Character Growth Section going live on November 14th and the full Space-Time Distortion update on November 21st.

This schedule allows players to experience the Character Growth Section for one week and the Space-Time Distortion for two weeks on the test server.  




In the first test week, only the initial phases of Space-Time Distortion will be available, with the full battle opening the following week. 

We will gather feedback and fix bugs as needed, addressing critical issues promptly regardless of the update schedule.




Stat requirements for the new Space-Time Distortion will be announced when the test server opens.

To ensure smooth testing, my team and I will patch unintended errors and provide stat-boosting items as needed.  




The diverse attack patterns from Jordra and Jörmungandr will challenge our testers, but I believe our players’ skill will conquer this battle even before the official release. 

The top-tier battle rewards for the 3rd Space-Time Distortion will include new artifacts and exclusive enchantments, granting additional effects based on artifact-enchantment combinations for optimized usage.  




Magic extraction will also become available for the Fallen One’s Rhod Compass, which will remain the highest-tier item without new Rhod Compass additions.  

This new Space-Time Distortion features a more captivating design, and I hope you look forward to its release. 

  




[b][26th Hero] 
[/b]
The 26th Heroine is scheduled for release this winter; however, I must announce that the planned December release will be postponed to January 2025.  

After careful consideration, I concluded that a January 2025 release would align better with the 15th Anniversary and Lunar New Year.  

Alongside the new hero release, a Golden Time Event will also occur in January.

Although the release has been delayed, we are preparing a special end-of-year event to celebrate with you. Thank you for understanding this schedule change. 




The 26th Hero marks a fresh attempt by our development team, and while details will be shared at a later time, I appreciate your patience as we finalize this exciting addition. 

[i]Note: For regions outside Korea, the delayed schedule does not apply, and development is proceeding as initially planned. [/i]

  




In early November, we’ll introduce the Recollection Crystal and a 2024 Cashback event, followed by a year-end event in December. January 2025 updates will be further discussed in our December DEV Talk clip. 




As it’s getting colder, I hope everyone stays healthy and keeps the flu at bay. 

Thank you.

notes.title: False Confession: Spinos
notes.content:
Hello! This is the Vindictus team.

The newest raid is called [b]False Confession[/b].

You can depart for [b]False Confession[/b] in Toward Taratha, through the Sen Mag Forest region.

​

 

[b]Spinos[/b], the priest of the previous heroes, made a decision that proves irrevocable. 

He confesses his sins to a god who does not answer. 

Now, all that's left for him is hatred... and doom.

​

An area is created, based on his wishes, that is dominated by a blazing sun and sandstorms. 

After experiencing contact with a forbidden power,[b] Spinos[/b] greets the heroes.

 

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1133/20240828010432642.jpg[/img]

<Spinos praying as he awaits the heroes at the altar.>

 

Within this region that [b]Spinos[/b] created, his magic reigns supreme.

He can harness sand to create or destroy anything and everything.

 

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1132/2024082801050761.jpg[/img]

​<Spinos unleashing his powerful sand magic.>

 

[b]Spinos[/b] hails from the Kingdom of the Sun and he well knows the unbridled power of lightning strikes in the desert.

He unleashes powerful attacks using the lightning harnessed by his weapon.

 

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1134/20240828010540798.jpg[/img]

​<Spinos using his weapon to invoke lightning.>

 

[b]Spinos[/b], enraged by the heroes, transforms his newfound arena in ways to put further pressure on them.

Harsh desert conditions will tire the heroes out as the battle rages on. 

 

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1135/20240828010601818.jpg[/img]

​<Spinos altering the environment to assail the heroes.>

 

When [b]Spinos[/b]'s fury reaches its peak, he taps into all of the magic he can access to summon a massive sandstorm.

You must find a place to hide—and quickly—before it engulfs the entire region.

 

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1136/20240828010616628.jpg[/img]

<Spinos summoning a vast sandstorm.>

 

The Season 4 Episode 10 raid, [b]False Confession[/b], will be live soon.

As always, we will do our best to provide you with a great gaming experience.

Thank you for supporting Vindictus!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953157/19665237b0f9d197088055d55294fac54253c4ca.jpg[/img]

Event Period: 9/24/2024 (Mon) after weekly maintenance - 10/15/2024 (Tue) before weekly maintenance

 

Mercenaries,

Is everyone familiar with the game, ‘I spy?’

We come up with an object in mind, and you will be guessing what we’re thinking of!

How familiar with the world of Vindictus are you?

 

Now, it’s time to begin.

I spy with my little eye…

 
[b]Event Info:[/b]
Each week, a new quiz will be revealed, starting the timer.
Once the quiz begins, you will have one week to find the exact target that we are thinking of, based on the hint given in the questions.
After a week, the former quiz will be closed, and you will not be able to add any answers.
Answer the question with a screenshot through the comment section of the post with the question.
 
[b]Information Needed to Participate:[/b]
[list][*]Server[/*][*]The Answer of the Week[/*][*]Screenshot of the answer[/*][/list]
 

[b]Reward Info:[/b]
[list][*]If over 20 answers are submitted each week, a coupon code containing **10 GM Coins** will be revealed to everyone.[/*][*]Otherwise, it will be exclusively disclosed to participants, regardless of validity of answers.[/*][*]Screenshots and Forum posts submitted may be used in future social posts.[/*][*]You may not participate multiple times.[/*][/list]


[b]Please Note:[/b]
[list][*]Each person can only participate once per week.[/*][*]Rewards will be given during maintenance on October 15th.[/*][*]Replies that are irrelevant or participation with other people's screenshots will not be counted.[/*][*]Replies that do not meet the Participation Format will not be counted.[/*][*]Submittions may be used in our official social accounts.[/*][/list]

notes.title: [Notice] End of Service Support for Operating Systems Below Windows 10
notes.content:
Dear Mercenaries, 

 

To maintain the stability and security of Vindictus, support for operating systems below Windows 10 has officially ended. 

If you're using an operating system older than Windows 10, please refer to the following information to avoid any disruptions while playing the game. 

 

1. Windows Version Check and Upgrade Guide 
[list][*]Checking your Windows version Press the Windows logo key + [R] simultaneously to open the Run dialog. [/*][*]Then type "winver" and press Enter to check your current Windows version. [/*][/list]
 

2. Upgrading your Windows version 
[list][*]If you have a license for Windows 10 or higher, you can upgrade by visiting the following page: [Go to Microsoft Website > Software Download] [/*][/list]
 

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and will continue to work hard to provide you with a pleasant gaming experience in Vindictus. 

 

Thank you.

notes.content:
[b]Table of Contents[/b]
[olist][*]Character Utility Improvements[/*][*]Battle[/*][/olist]
 

[b]1. Character Utility Improvements[/b]

The first character utility improvement update for 2024 is being conducted.

 
[table][tr][td]
Developer's Notes: 

This character utility improvement consists of 8 characters, with improvements being made on aspects that felt unpleasant or unreasonable when playing as them.

 

While one goal was to minimize changes to how each of these characters operate, there may be some less predictable changes in DPS performance, depending on what was altered. For now, we will keep the power of each skill the same while applying the changes below, but please understand that we may need to adjust the power level of some skills down the road.

 

Additionally, it seems that Sanyaa is performing well in all raids right now, but since it is difficult to apply changes so soon after release, we plan to make appropriate adjustments to her once we have more data. However, we do not plan on changing the structure of the character. We will instead make changes by adjusting her damage output.
[/td][/tr][/table]
 

[b]Sylas[/b]
[list][*]When you are attacked by an enemy during the following, the period in which the attack animation does not occur will increase by approximately 24%.[list][*] Wraith Slash[/*][*] Wraith Shot[/*][*] Phantom Shooter[/*][*] Cyclone Saw[/*][/list][/*][/list]
 
[list][*]Following attacks have an added aspect where Sylas can dodge enemies' attacks.[list][*] Cyclone Crash <Enhanced Attack> (added 30 frames) [/*][*] Illusion Fist <Enhanced Attack> (added 33 frames) [/*][/list][/*][/list]
 
[list][*]Following active skills have an added aspect where Sylas can dodge enemies' attacks. [list][*] Active: Impulse Zone (added 45 frames)[/*][*] Active: Illusion Shield (added 35 frames)[/*][/list][/*][/list]
 
[list][*]When the following attacks are successful, the number of Phantom Shards that can be obtained is increased from 2 to 3. [list][*] Normal Attack (3rd hit)[/*][*] Normal Attack (4th hit)[/*][/list][/*][/list]
 
[list][*]When the Spirit Rend attack is successful, the amount of stamina recovered is increased from 20 to 35.[/*][/list][list][*]Fixed the issue where damage was occasionally applied multiple times when attacking with Wraith Slash in battle.[/*][/list][list][*]When acquiring a Phantom Shard through a normal attack, the duration will be displayed as a status effect.[/*][/list][list][*]The M. ATT and DEF effects of the Phantom Force status effect per stage are updated as follows.[/*][/list][table][tr][td]

[b]Lynn - Glaive[/b]
[list][*]Killer Dart attack can be used without charging for the following attacks. [list][*] Thunderleg[/*][*] Little Rat[/*][*] Wind Step[/*][/list][/*][/list]

[list][*]Fixed being able to use Killer Dart without charging (by using Phoenix Feather, etc.) during battle.[list][*] When using Killer Dart by charging while moving, the fastest time Lynn can activate it (from the moment Lynn begins charging) is increased by approximately 15 frames.[/*][*] When attacking with Killer Dart, the range at which enemies are hit is increased.[/*][*] When you use Killer Dart after Wind Step, the distance the character moves is approximately 50% of the distance of the basic Killer Dart attack.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
 
[list][*]Fixed it so Thunderleg does not chain to Iron Monkey.[/*][*]When attacking with Five Finger Death, the range at which enemies are hit is increased. [/*][*]When attacking with Five Finger Death, if the boss or the last monster hit is nearby, the camera will quickly rotate towards the target and the attack will happen while looking straight ahead. [/*][*]Improved so that when successfully attacking with Fishtail Pole, 2 Swift Assassin Strikes are inflicted.[/*][*]When attacking with Active: Iron Flag, the range of the forward explosion attack is slightly increased.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where key inputs would not apply when using Thunderleg, by rapidly inputting the dodge key in succession while using Active: Jade Fox.[/*][*]The attack range for Active: Chambers of Death is slightly increased.[/*][/list][table][tr][td]
Developer's Notes: 

There was an inconvenient and unreasonable structure in place, where effectively using Glaive Lynn required near-exploits, such as using Killer Dart without charging through Phoenix Feathers, to reach her full potential.

 

However, considering that the "Phoenix Feather Play" has been used for a long time now, we modified it so that Killer Dart can be used immediately without charging after a specific action. Due to this update, there's an expected change in performance for the entire player base (including players who did not use the technique) so we will closely monitor her results.
[/td][/tr][/table]
 

[b]Dan-Ah[/b]
[list][*]When using Soul Tracer, the timing to switch to movement is adjusted to be faster without having to dodge or perform other actions.[/*][*]MP Cost for using Soul Tracer is decreased from 70 to 60. [/*][*]When using the Fickle Fate attack, the timing in which the enemy's attack can be offset is increased by 13% compared to previously.[/*][*]When using Soul Barrier, the timing in which you can defend against enemy attacks is increased by 14% compared to previously.[/*][*]When Active: Great Beyond is activated, the range at which enemies are hit is increased.[/*][/list]
 
[list][*]When using Final Gate: Purge and Final Gate: Unleashed, and then using Curse Breaker without inputting a directional key at the same time, the distance traveled is decreased.[/*][*]Improved it so that stamina is recovered by 15 when the Curse Breaker attack is successful.[/*][*]When using Soul Tracer, the period in which you can dodge enemy attacks is increased by 28%. [/*][/list]
 
[list][*]When using Soul Strike, the range at which enemies can be attacked is slightly increased. [/*][*]The timing for chaining Spirited Dash after attacking an enemy with the additional hit from Soul Strike has been adjusted to be 8 frames faster than before.[/*][/list]
 
[list][*]When using Soul Barrier, the distance Dan-Ah moves backwards is decreased.[/*][*]When using Soul Tracer after successfully defending with Soul Barrier, throwing weapons have improved accuracy. [/*][/list]
 
[list][*]When using Spirited Dash, MVT SPD is increased by 10% compared to previously.[list][*] The timing for the dodge hit box is the same as before.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]When using Active: Ritual of Ending without inputting a directional key at the same time, the forward distance traveled is decreased.[list][*] If you input the directional keys you will attack, moving the same distance forward as before.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
 

 

[b]Delia[/b]

[list][*]When successfully attacking with Rising Comet, the effect duration of Keen, Perfect Keen, and Fighting Spirit are increased by up to 1 second.[/*][*]When successfully attacking with Falling Comet, the effect duration of Keen, Perfect Keen, and Fighting Spirit will increase by up to 2 seconds.[/*][/list]
 
[list][*]Updated Full Moon as follows:[list][*] Updated so that when hitting an enemy with a finisher attack, you gain 20 SP.[/*][*] Updated so that after the finisher attack, it can be chained starting from the second hit of the normal attack.[/*][*] Updated so that when performing a finisher attack, the effect durations of Keen, Perfect Keen, and Fighting Spirit are increased 0.5 seconds.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
 
[list][*]Updated Active: Zenith as follows:[list][*] Removes the effect of destroying armor when used.[/*][*] Updated Active: Zenith so that it can be used in Royal Army.[/*][*] The duration of the Fighting Spirit and Perfect Keen effects obtained upon use have been adjusted from 120 seconds to 130 seconds each, and the timing at which the effects are applied have been adjusted from after the skill animation has finished to immediately after the skill is used.[/*][*] There was a problem with the Fighting Spirit and Perfect Keen effects sometimes not applying when another animation was played, following the use of Active: Zenith. It has been adjusted as noted above.[/*][*] When using Rising Comet or Falling Comet, while the Fighting Spirit effect still remains after using Active: Zenith, the Vigor effect will be updated to Stage 3.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
 
[list][*]Rising Comet and Falling Comet are added to the Full Force activation requirement.[/*][/list]
 
[list][*]Added a sparkling effect to the tip of the Bastard Sword in the following situations, as well as sound effects.[list][*] After learning Rising Comet, it can chain from Rings of Saturn.[/*][*] After learning Falling Comet, it can chain from Orbital Flurry.[/*][*] After learning Falling Comet, it can chain from Active: Cosmic Blitz.[/*][*] A dodge hit box is added in above situations, from when the effect begins until the end of the animation.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
 
[list][*]Fixed it so that Wild Star's charge attack always grants the Lv. 1 Vigor effect.[list][*] If the attack is successful, you will gain 2 additional Vigor stages just like before, allowing you to obtain the Vigor Stage 3 effect.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
 
[list][*]Updated to allow chaining Active: Ion Thrust after the following attacks.[list][*] Solar Flare[/*][*] Starbloom[/*][*] Lunar Assault[list][*]In accordance with the above changes, the skill description of Active: Ion Thrust will include the types of skills that can be chained.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
 
[list][*]The stamina consumption of Meteor Impact was reduced.[/*][/list][table][tr][td]

[/td][/tr][/table][list][*]Adds the new status effect Rose's Revenge.[list][*] When Delia successfully blocks an enemy's attack with Eclipse, a red rose effect will appear, and she will gain the Rose's Revenge status effect.[/*][*] This status effect lasts for 20 seconds and increases the damage of the next Rising Comet or Falling Comet by 30%.[/*][*] Added a description of the new status effect, Rose's Revenge, to the skill description of Eclipse.[/*][/list][/*][/list][table][tr][td]
Developer's Notes:

The penalty for Delia's powerful Active: Zenith was too strong and made it difficult to use across the game, the cycle took too long to prepare, and the Vigor effect did not fit the current raid meta. It was determined that these aspects were what made playing Delia inconvenient and unreasonable.

 

The effect of her armor being destroyed when using Active: Zenith made it difficult to use in content like Space Time Distortions. 

 

We went back and forth about removing the armor destruction effect because it was Delia's unique concept... but we decided that it was just too harsh for Delia, who lacks defensive mechanics. We ask for understanding from players who prefer her original armor destruction concept. 

 

Additionally, we made a change to continuously renew Vigor effect to stage 3 after using Active: Zenith, while the Fighting Spirit effect is active, so that players can focus on dealing damage while in that state.

 

Also, the Perfect Keen effect was changed to slightly increase in duration when performing certain actions. This should complement Delia's DPS performance in long battles rather than short ones.

 

Delia is currently showing low DPS performance in Redeemers and Space Time Distortion battles, but with the above changes we hope she will be improved somewhat.
[/td][/tr][/table]
 

[b]Latiya[/b]

Restoring Warrior's Claw is the same as before.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
 

 

[b]Letty[/b]

[list][*]When the following attacks hit an enemy within a certain range, damage is increased by 5%. When the damage increase effect is applied, the damage is marked in yellow.[list][*] Trooper: Crushing Blow, Trooper: Twisting Blow (Normal attack 2 times - Smash Combo)[/*][*] Trooper: Piercing Strike, Trooper: Storm Smite (Normal attack 3 times - Smash Combo)[/*][*] To avoid confusion with the above effect, other damage previously marked in yellow is changed to red.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
 
[list][*]Updated Swift Recoil as follows:[list][*] When guarding an enemy attack with Swift Recoil, cooldown decreases by 3 seconds.[/*][*] When using Swift Recoil, the long press control is removed. However, the motion can still be used with the same long movement distance by pressing the directional keys at the same time.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
 
[list][*]Projectile hit radius is increased by 30% when enemies are nearby, making it easier to hit with Kradie Blast and Kradie Burst.[/*][*]Using a normal attack, after using Quick Slip or Slip Sliding, will now chain to a second normal attack.[/*][/list]
 
[table][tr][td]
Developer's Notes:

Letty is one of the characters in charge of Core Breakoff in a raid party, but recently (as the play time for battles has become shorter) there have been frequent instances where Letty cannot use Active: Firecracker twice. Therefore, we've added an additional effect of destroying weak points for Active: Letty Bomba.

 

We've also made it easier to destroy weak points with Active: Firecracker. We've increased the duration of the bomb and made it possible to enhance its stages with Standing Flip and Active: Beautiful Blaze, so that you can reliably force an explosion even in situations where you don't have time to use the Normal Attack x2 - Smash Combo or the Normal Attack x3 - Smash Combo.

 

Additionally, we have strengthened the damage compensation for close combat situations and corrected the issue where Swift Recoil would jump you far back and unintentionally increase the distance. Now you can fight while maintaining your desired distance.
[/td][/tr][/table]
 

 

[b]Evie - Battle Scythe[/b]
[list][*]The drain motion that follows use of the skills below is updated to be approximately 20% faster than before.[list][*] Life Drain [/*][*] Spirit Bind [/*][*] Mark of Death[/*][*] Bloody Thread[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]After using the following skill, the motion when moving or standing to release will be updated to be approximately 20% faster than before.[list][*] Life Drain[/*][*] Spirit Bind[/*][*] Mark of Death[/*][*] Bloody Thread[/*][/list][/*][*]Fixed an issue where the Active: Arcane Gate skill would not be canceled if hit by an enemy while using it.[/*][/list]

[list][*]Time allowed to chain the next attack has been adjusted to be approximately 30% longer than before.[list][*] Kasana[/*][*] Active: Cleave[/*][/list][/*][*]The activation hit box for Kasana has been updated to make it easier to activate.[/*][/list]
 
[list][*]The dodge range applied to the recoil-based jumps in Aerial Evasion, Handspring, and Aerial Smash have been extended to until when Grimden lands.[list][*] Aerial Evasion and Handspring were previously structured so that the dodge zone would increase depending on the skill rank. This has been updated so that the dodge zone will be applied until the landing point, regardless of rank.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
 
[list][*]The cooldown applied when using Aerial Evasion, after defending against an enemy attack from the front, is adjusted from 10 seconds to 5.[/*][*]Adjusted the time during which you can block an enemy attack with Occluded Soul and then chain to Aerial Evasion or Handspring.[list][*] Previously - Can be chained up to 30 frames after using Occluded Soul[/*][*] Updated - Can be chained up to 45 frames after using Occluded Soul[/*][/list][/*][/list]
 
[list][*]To more intuitively show when the Mortal Arts Shadow Ambush damage multiplier is enhanced 1 time for a set duration during Dark Charge, the Mortal Arts Enhanced status effect is added.[list][*] When using Mortal Arts, while its Enhanced status effect is active, the status effect will end regardless of whether or not Shadow Ambush is used.[/*][*] Added relevant information to the skill description of Dark Charge.[/*][/list][/*][/list][table][tr][td]
Developer's Notes: 

The method of increasing the Shadow Ambush damage multiplier through Mortal Arts after using Grimden's Dark Charge skill was only applicable by successfully doing it within a limited action time of 1 second, and it was inconvenient because it did not show when the effect was active.

 

To improve this part, the Mortal Arts Enhanced status effect was added after Dark Charge to make it more intuitive, and the many action restrictions were changed so that the damage multiplier will increase even when performing other actions, as long as a successful Mortal Arts was performed through Shadow Ambush while the effect is active.

 

Additionally, the effect duration was buffed from 1 second to 3 seconds.

 

With this patch, we expect that it will be easier to successfully use Mortal Arts Shadow Ambush after the Dark Charge skill.
[/td][/tr][/table]

notes.title: Sanyaa: The Lost Outsider
notes.content:
Hello, this is the Vindictus team.

Today we're introducing the [b]25th[/b] hero of Vindictus, [b]Sanyaa.[/b]

 

She is a female character who wields [b]Dual Knives[/b].

 

These are fast and precise weapons that target the weaknesses of her enemies and are a perfect match for her hand-to-hand skills. 

Utilizing combat resources that build up over the course of the fight, players will be able to experience dynamic gameplay.

As you dodge enemy attacks and successfully counterattack, certain moves become more powerful, and can turn the tide of battle in your favor.

She's a fun character to play, with quick attacks and deft dodges! 

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1367/sanyaa1.jpg[/img]

[b](Sanyaa with Dual Knives)[/b]

 
[list][*][b]Quickly dodge enemy attacks[/b][/*][/list]
Sanyaa is a character who specializes in dodging incoming attacks.

You have two basic dodges and can use [b]Egret Step[/b] to quickly dodge in emergencies.

 

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1368/sanyaa2.jpg[/img]

[b](Sanyaa dodging enemy attacks)[/b]

 
[list][*][b]Dodge and counterattack[/b][/*][/list]
Sanyaa can rapidly counter with a [b]Shadow Reprisal[/b] if she times her dodge.

If you successfully counter with [b]Shadow Reprisal[/b], you'll be in a [b]Playful[/b] state for a period of time.

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1369/sanyaa3.jpg[/img]

[b](Counterattacking Sanyaa)[/b]

 
[list][*][b]Playful[/b][/*][/list]
When Sanyaa is being Playful, her [b]Heron Step[/b] skill is enhanced to [b]Shadow Play[/b] to dance around her adversaries.  

In addition, her [b]Swift Slash[/b] skill is enhanced to [b]Play Rough[/b], which can turn the tide of battle in your favor. 

 

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1370/sanyaa4.jpg[/img]

[b](Sanyaa attacking with Play Rough)[/b]

 
[list][*][b]Sanyaa's quick approach and powerful skills[/b][/*][/list]
Sanyaa's [b]Active: Thief's Mark[/b] allows her to mark her enemies.

After marking them, re-entering an active skill during its duration will allow Sanyaa to quickly approach and attack the marked target.

 

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1371/sanyaa5.jpg[/img]

[b](Sanyaa approaching the marked target)[/b]

 

"[b]Active: Take Flight[/b]" is a skill that attacks enemies by spinning in midair.

From the moment you spin, you can change direction with the directional keys.

 

[img]https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1372/sanyaa6.jpg[/img]

 

Other moves include "[b]Active: Vanishing Dance[/b]," which lets you disappear for a moment and then attack, "[b]Active: Crescent Kick[/b]," and more.

She has a number of active skills that can be utilized in different combat situations.

 

That's Sanyaa, our upcoming 25th hero in Vindictus.

We'll always do our best to provide you with a fun and enjoyable experience.

[b][ABOUT][/b]

The Lost Outsider of Dusk and Dawn

Sanyaa was sent away from home at a young age, growing up in a mysterious thieves' guild. 

An altruistic noble by day; a mysterious thief by night. 

She enjoyed her double life... until it all came crashing down.

Stalking that vicious culprit leads her to Colhen. 

 

Sanyaa's Dual Knives allow for swift and exact targeting of enemy weak points, 

and they harmonize well with her close combat skills. 

She gains battle resources as she attacks, allowing for a thrilling experience. 

If she successfully dodges an enemy's attack and counters, 

certain moves become more powerful, turning the battle to her favor. 

She's an appealing character with enthralling gameplay, using fast attacks and nimble dodges.
